title: Supply Chain Solutions Manager
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Every company runs on an ERP. Very few get good decisions out of it. That's where Praxas comes in.

Praxas AI is an AI-native supply chain platform that works as a decision layer on top of the systems a company already has. We pull in scattered data from ERPs, spreadsheets and email, turn it into a single, trusted picture, and use optimization models and AI agents to recommend what to produce, stock, buy and ship. Plans keep re-optimizing as orders, capacity and supply change, and planners stay in control by approving every action.

What we stand for is simple: no rip-and-replace, no multi-year implementations, and no multi-million-dollar planning suites. We're building planning software that's fast to deploy, easy to use and priced for mid-sized companies.

We're starting with production planning for manufacturers, because that's where our first clients feel the most pain. Inventory, sourcing and shipping come next, followed by industries such as CPG, retail, chemicals and logistics. Our first manufacturing partners are already sharing their data and building the product with us. Built in India, for the world.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with our clients and turn their messiest supply chain problems into optimized plans running in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a traditional consulting, project management or customer success position. You'll sit with planners and plant heads to understand how the business really runs, formulate the right mathematical model, write production-quality code, connect our platform to their ERP, and stay until the plan is trusted and used every day. You'll move between a factory floor, a solver, an ERP database and a conversation with the owner without losing the thread.

Our clients' data lives in SAP, Tally, custom ERPs, spreadsheets and inboxes, and it's rarely clean. The work is never turnkey. You'll own hard implementation problems through to resolution, and turn what you learn in the field into reusable connectors, models and playbooks that make the next deployment faster.

You'll work directly with the founders and our engineering team. As one of our first hires, you'll help define how Praxas is built, deployed and sold.

**What You Will Do**

Deliver supply chain solutions

• Embed with clients from discovery through go-live, stabilization and handover

• Map each client's production, inventory, sourcing and logistics processes, and the data behind them

• Translate business goals and ambiguous requirements into clear models, milestones and working software

• Own the outcomes clients care about: fewer lost sales, better on-time-in-full delivery, higher inventory turns and working capital released

Model and optimize

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling, inventory and safety stock, demand forecasting and supply planning problems

• Use linear and mixed-integer programming, constraint programming and heuristics, with solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX or OR-Tools

• Build models that re-optimize continuously as orders, capacity and supply change

• Validate models against real client data, test them on past periods, and explain trade-offs clearly to planners

Engineer in the client environment

• Write production-quality code in Python and SQL

• Build and maintain ERP connectors for SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics and custom databases, using APIs, OData and direct SQL

• Build data pipelines and data-quality checks, and reconcile Praxas numbers with the client's own reports

• Deploy and troubleshoot client environments on AWS, working within each client's IT and security controls

• Integrate AI agents into planning workflows, with human approval at every step

Build client capability

• Run workshops, design reviews and hands-on training for planners, purchase teams and plant heads

• Build trust in the system's recommendations so clients act on them every day

• Communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to planners, managers and owners

• Keep scope disciplined and make realistic technical commitments

Make the product better

• Turn recurring client needs into product features, reusable connectors and deployment templates

• Cut implementation time with every deployment

• Write clear documentation: data maps, model specs, runbooks and decision logs

**What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days**

• Build a working knowledge of the Praxas data model, planning engine and deployment setup

• Take one client from data access to a production plan running on their live data, with numbers that match their own reports

• Build or strengthen at least one reusable ERP connector

• Write documentation that makes the next client onboarding faster

**Within 6–12 months**

• Lead several client deployments end to end, from discovery to daily use

• Cut onboarding time from weeks to days

• Show measurable impact at your clients, such as fewer lost sales, lower inventory and better on-time delivery

• Turn field lessons into product features, connectors and playbooks the whole team uses

Who You Are

Required

• 3–8 years building or implementing supply chain planning solutions, at a platform such as o9, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis or SAP IBP, at an implementation partner, or in a similar role

• Exceptional coding ability: you write production-quality Python and SQL, and you're comfortable with APIs, data pipelines and cloud deployment

• Strong operations research and mathematical modelling: linear and mixed-integer programming, scheduling, heuristics, forecasting and inventory theory

• Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning, including building with large language models and AI agents and applying them to planning problems

• Hands-on experience integrating with ERPs such as SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or custom systems

• Deep understanding of at least two of production planning and scheduling, demand planning, inventory planning, S&OP, procurement and logistics

• Proven client-facing skills: you can run a workshop, gather requirements and explain a model to someone who isn't technical

• Comfortable working on factory floors and travelling to client sites

Nice to have

• Experience in manufacturing, which is extremely beneficial

• A degree in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics

• Time at a startup or on an early product team

Compensation and Equity

• Competitive salary, with raises tied to company milestones

• Meaningful equity through ESOPs, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, so you own part of what you help build

• Early-team ownership: a real say in the product, the way we deploy it and the culture we build

**How to Apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to admin@praxas.ai with the subject line "Forward Deployed Engineer – Supply Chain". Include a short note on a model or integration you built, and what changed for the client because of it.

title: Category Development Analyst
description:
**Category Development Analyst**

**Welcome to BIG W**

For over 50 years, we’ve been helping Aussie families find those little wins. Who makes it all happen? Our team. They’re our biggest asset, the heart of everything we do. From new ideas to big energy and genuine care, they bring it every day, on every shift, at every shelf and in every customer moment.

We’re part of the largest Australian employer group, a community icon, and our scale opens the door to career possibilities as big as your ambition. Whether you’re on the shop floor, in one of our dynamic support offices, or a bustling distribution centre, we’ll back you to grow, make an impact, and feel proud to be part of something that truly matters.

Think you’d look good in blue? A career at BIG W could be the perfect gig for you.

**What you’ll do**

Part of the Category Development team, this role is responsible for partnering across the commercial (buying) teams to deliver on refreshed category plans, improved financials through COGS negotiation support and driving strategic initiatives to deliver on our customer promise. Successful delivery in this role will be underpinned by effectively leveraging our data to create insights to inform and reshape our customer offer and drive growth, identifying and generating opportunities for value creation with suppliers.

As a key member of the Category Development team, you will support our commercial (buying) teams by turning data into actionable insights. You will learn the fundamentals of category analysis and play a vital role in helping us understand our customers and improve our product ranges.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

* **Update**
  our category factbases, quarterly commodity report, and other regular reports issued by the Category Development team.
* **Assist**
  in analysing cost price increase requests received from suppliers.
* **Help**
  prepare the data and analysis required and vendor facing materials to support the category teams in supplier negotiations.
* **Support**
  Senior Category Development Analysts
  in assessing supplier proposals.
* **Support**
  with recording outcomes of closed supplier negotiations.
* **Develop**
  your skills in structured problem-solving and learn how to translate complex data into simple, clear recommendations.
* **Contribute**
  to projects by preparing reports, building dashboards, and presenting findings to the team.
* **Participate**
  in the creation of ranging analytics tools and roll-out of best practice Buying processes.

**What you’ll bring**

We are looking for someone with a strong analytical mindset and a genuine desire to learn and grow. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should have a solid foundation and a proactive attitude.

* A developing commercial acumen with a keen interest in the retail industry.
* Good communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical concepts clearly.
* A high level of attention to detail and the ability to present information neatly and accurately.
* A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to work with complex information.
* A Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field; or 1-2 years of experience in an analytical role.
* **Strong skills in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets are essential.**
  Basic knowledge of SQL is a big advantage, but not required. Basic knowledge of Anaplan is useful, but not required.
* A curious, proactive, and collaborative mindset.

**What you’ll experience**

* A global business with endless career possibilities around every corner and across every discipline – with valuable exposure to a vast and exciting business network

**We are Woolworths Group**

We are Woolworths Group. 200,000+ bright minds, passionate hearts, and unique perspectives across Australia and New Zealand. Connected by a shared Purpose - 'to create better experiences together for a better tomorrow'. That Purpose fuels our ambition to explore new ideas, make brave commitments, and innovate better ways to meet the food and everyday needs of more than 24 million customers every week.

If you're excited to turn today's blue-sky thinking into a better tomorrow for future generations, you'll find yourself supported and enriched in a dynamic, inclusive, and empowering workplace. With a culture of genuine care, a flexible approach to work, and opportunities across the group to grow your career and make a meaningful impact, the possibilities for what we can achieve together are endless.

**Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group**

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.

We encourage all candidates to apply; please let us know in your application if we can support you with any adjustments in the hiring process.

**See how we’re creating better experiences together, for a better tomorrow**

**Discover more opportunities with Woolworths Group**

title: Creative Data Strategist (Associate Managing Consultant(-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Creative Data Strategist (Associate Managing Consultant(-1
  
  
**Overview**
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally.
  
  
The Advisors Creative Desk sits within Services as a full-service creative and advertising capability, helping Services clients build and grow their brands through end-to-end solutions, from brand positioning and strategy to creative development, campaigns, and content.
  
  
The Creative Data Strategist turns data, research, and customer intelligence into clear insights that shape creative strategy and drive more effective campaigns, experiences, and creative solutions. Serving as a partner to regional ACD Strategy teams worldwide, this role translates complex information into actionable opportunities, shapes strategic recommendations, and enhances the impact and effectiveness of creative work.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with strategic thinking and storytelling, transforming complex data into clear narratives that inspire action and strengthen strategic and creative decision-making.
  
  
Role
  
  
As a Creative Data Strategist, you will support regional ACD Strategy teams worldwide through data-driven analysis, audience intelligence, and market insights across a broad range of client engagements.
  
  

* Gather, interpret, and synthesize quantitative and qualitative data, leveraging consumer and audience intelligence platforms to uncover actionable insights and strategic opportunities.
* Translate data, research, and audience intelligence into clear strategic recommendations and creative opportunities.
* Support the development of strategic briefs, audience strategies, customer engagement approaches, and campaign recommendations.
* Identify emerging trends, shifting consumer behaviors, and evolving customer needs to inform strategic and creative development.
* Present insights, findings, and recommendations to internal teams and clients in a clear, compelling, and actionable manner.
* Explore emerging tools, methodologies, and data sources to enhance ACD's strategic capabilities and insight development.
* Contribute to thought leadership, knowledge sharing, and best practices across the broader organization.

**All About You**

* 8+ years of experience in data strategy, consumer insights, or marketing analytics roles within advertising agencies, preferably full-service network agencies.
* Proven ability to translate data, research, and customer insights into strategic recommendations, creative opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of brand, marketing, communications, customer, and campaign effectiveness frameworks.
* Experience working closely with strategy, creative, and client teams to develop insight-led campaigns, experiences, and engagement programs.
* Ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative data into clear, actionable, and compelling narratives.
* Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience using consumer and audience intelligence platforms such as YouGov, GWI, TGI, or similar tools to uncover customer, category, and market insights.

Proficiency in data visualization and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent tools.
  
  

* Familiarity with digital, social, CRM, customer, and campaign measurement frameworks, methodologies, and analytics tools.
* Knowledge of AI-powered analytics, audience intelligence, and emerging data capabilities is a plus.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and consulting skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional proficiency in English is required
* Bachelor's degree required; postgraduate qualifications in data, analytics, mathematics, statistics, or related disciplines are a plus.
* Open to occasional travel as required.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Workforce Management Specialist IV
description:
**About The Role**

* As a Workforce Management Specialist IV, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring operational excellence within the Global Delivery team. You will collaborate with global partners, provide actionable insights, and drive process improvements to align with business goals. This position offers an opportunity to work on challenging and impactful projects that influence the operational efficiency of Uber's BPO partners
* You realize the vital role that staffing plays in appropriately cultivating positive experiences with our eater, courier, and merchant partners, allowing for positive support experiences every time, all the time
* You are a big thinker and never view problems that arise as microscopic, but rather take a step back to make decisions that are in the best interest of the Uber and our community
* You are a resourceful go-getter, always willing to take initiative and address something hands-on, you persevere when others give up
* Optimistic leadership: you are passionate about making magic for our Community

**What the Candidate Will Do**

* Managing SLAs and response times ensures our customers are having a happy time using Uber.
* Ensure accuracy in WFM data sources (e.g., efficiency dashboards, inflow vs. forecast reports, data quality checks) to enhance data reliability for customer-impacting decisions.
* Act as a subject-matter expert by managing performance monitoring to ensure SLAs are met, and engage in capacity planning that anticipates customer needs.
* Serve as a point of contact, providing weekly insights and updates to keep stakeholders informed on capacity, productivity, and service effectiveness.
* Assist the development and refinement of forecast models, supporting proactive capacity adjustments
* Oversee weekly inputs and discrepancies for BPO capacity calls and maintain an organized approach to data validation on allocation and capacity sheets.
* Structure performance analyses to highlight root causes of SLA misses or productivity variances and coordinate with sites for course corrections.
* Manage and analyze data for capacity and forecast accuracy, ensuring both strategic planning and execution are aligned with broader objectives.
* Lead weekly deviation calls to address forecast adjustments and plan for any operational changes impacting the organization's performance.
* Engage with SRPs, BI, A&I, and BPs as the primary contact, ensuring a well-aligned and informed network of stakeholders.
* Manage collaborative forecast and capacity review calls with BPOs and calibrate expectations to improve service delivery and organizational cohesion.
* Actively participate in CX syncs to discuss ongoing challenges, including SLAs, roadblocks, and project milestones, promoting clear communication and visibility across teams.
* Present and discuss insights and performance findings in team meetings, highlighting improvement areas and progress toward goals.
* Perform modifications and enhancements on existing reports based on evolving business requirements
* Basic project and stakeholder management
* Work in US CST timezone

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years work experience in Business Analytics, Workforce Planning, Management, or Business Process
* Exceptional written and verbal communication and organisational skills
* Collaborator within your team, as well as externally
* Experience with Google Sheets/Excel and preferably SQL, plenty of experience working with data
* English fluency
* Experience with WFM software (Verint, IEX, Aspect, etc.)
* Work in a high-growth environment
* Work in US CST timezone

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Intermediate stakeholder management skills with a proven ability to align conflicting priorities and lead through influence.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate high-ambiguity environments and stay resilient through constant change.
* Strong systems thinking with a focus on executional excellence and precise, high-stakes detail.
* Exceptional foresight and planning skills, with a track record of identifying operational risks before they impact service levels.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. title: Responsible AI / Eval Specialist
description:

**In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.**
**About The Role.**
The Responsible-AI / Eval Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, and operating evaluation frameworks that determine whether AI use cases are ready to progress through governance stage-gates and into production. This role serves as the hands-on execution arm of McCain’s Responsible AI standards, working closely with AI Platform & Engineering, Knowledge Engineering, Forward Deployment Engineers, and Security teams to evaluate accuracy, reliability, fairness, robustness, and overall quality across the McCain AI ecosystem. The role supports AI solutions built on Azure, Anthropic foundation models, Distyl technologies, Databricks, SAP, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* Design and execute evaluation strategies for AI use cases, including assessments of accuracy, reliability, hallucination rates, fairness, and robustness.
* Build, maintain, and operate evaluation harnesses, benchmark suites, and golden datasets across the McCain AI technology stack.
* Conduct stage-gate evaluations and provide clear, actionable findings to support governance decisions.
* Run bias and fairness testing across protected attributes and business-relevant user groups.
* Identify, quantify, and communicate fairness concerns while recommending practical remediation approaches.
* Lead red-team and adversarial testing exercises to identify vulnerabilities, failure modes, prompt injection risks, and jailbreak scenarios.
* Partner with Enterprise Security teams to strengthen AI resilience through broader adversarial testing initiatives.
* Support risk classification activities by providing evaluation evidence and recommendations that inform governance decisions.
* Collaborate with AI Platform & Engineering and Knowledge Engineering teams to embed evaluation capabilities into AI development workflows.
* Maintain model cards, evaluation reports, decision logs, and other governance documentation while contributing to Responsible AI standards and playbooks.
* Coach AI Engineers and Forward Deployment Engineers on evaluation best practices and quality disciplines.
* Share evaluation insights, frameworks, and reusable patterns across the AI organization.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful.**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in AI/ML evaluation, model validation, model risk management, or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML evaluation methodologies and performance metrics, including accuracy, calibration, fairness, and robustness.
* Experience evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents using frameworks such as HELM, Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong Python programming skills and experience with common machine learning evaluation and testing tools.
* Experience working with Databricks or comparable enterprise data platforms.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI and AI governance frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, or similar standards.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience conducting bias testing, red-team exercises, adversarial testing, and AI risk assessments is highly desirable.

The Responsible-AI / Eval Specialist is part of McCain’s AI governance and delivery ecosystem and works closely with the Use Case Governance & Operations Lead. The role partners across AI Platform & Engineering, Knowledge Engineering, Forward Deployment Engineering, Enterprise Security, and business stakeholders to ensure AI use cases meet quality, risk, and Responsible AI standards before deployment. title: Associate, Performance Improvement
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
  
  
The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Associate, Performance Improvement (PI) role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to assume a wide range of responsibilities and make a significant impact. The Associate, PI is a key contributor helping to conduct analysis and identify value creation opportunities. This Associate will support engagements that enhance efficiency, accuracy and decision-making for clients facing complex financial, transactional and operational challenges. This person will support key initiatives, execute discrete workstreams and collaborate closely with senior leaders. If you thrive in a high-performance culture and want to help build the future of a rapidly growing consultancy, this is the right role for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support commercial and operational due diligence, including deep-dive analysis of commercial opportunities, cost structures, working capital and operational KPIs
* Perform detailed data analysis and root-cause diagnostics across functions such as procurement, supply chain, manufacturing and SG&A
* Build and maintain robust financial and operational models, including cash flow, liquidity and cost-saving tracking tools
* Assist in developing 100-day plans and value creation roadmaps with clearly defined initiatives and impact estimates
* Track and report value capture initiatives, including savings realization and EBITDA impact
* Prepare high-quality client-ready materials for global stakeholders under tight timelines
* Partner with senior executives, private equity firms, lenders, lawyers and other related buyers
* Collaborate with U.S.-based teams to ensure alignment and seamless execution across time zones
* Contribute to a high-performing, inclusive and values-driven culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or CA preferred
* Experience working with U.S.-based private equity or corporate clients
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* At least two years of experience in consulting, transaction advisory or corporate strategy / operations
* Strong exposure to operational improvement, cost reduction or restructuring environments

title: Specialist Chargeback
description:
**Job Description**
Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc., (ACT) is a global Fortune 200 company. A leader in the convenience store and fuel space, it has footprint across 31 countries and territories. The Chargeback Specialist will be a key player in Global Payment Operations team that will help grow payment analytics globally at ACT.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing the chargebacks for all streams of Circle K credit card acceptance.
  
  
This role will require an understanding of payment processing, fraud detection, and reconciliation, as well as the ability to work closely with various internal and external groups to mitigate and prevent future chargebacks
  
  
**About The Role**
This candidate will also provide advanced analytics used to decrease chargebacks with driving process enhancements by researching and interpreting trends, solving various data and analytic needs, conducting exploratory data analysis, and creation of polished deliverables.
  
  
***Roles & Responsibilities***
***Analytics & Strategy***

* Analyse large-scale structured data; develop deep-dive analyses
* Organize a large amount of data
* Develop process to enhance chargeback process
* Regular progress and program reporting

***Operational Excellence***

* Partner with respective team(s) to build, design, maintain, and automated dashboards and reporting

***Stakeholder Engagement***

* Working collaboratively across multiple sets of stakeholders – Internal (Accounting, Retail Systems, D&A groups, etc) and external (Issuers, Payment Brands, Processors, etc)
* Articulate work results to management

***Job Requirements***
***Education***

* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably with a background with history of data analysis, or equivalent work experience

***Relevant Experience***

* 2 plus years of work experience
* Relevant working experience data analytics
* End to End Program Management & Maintenance
* Ability to develop documented processes and procedures

***Behavioural Skills***

* Proven experience in analytics
* Communication excellence
* Independent worker
* Innovation and agility

***Knowledge***

* Payment processing knowledge is preferred
* Strong analytics skill-set
* Strong communication skills
* Enterprise reporting systems, relational (MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server etc.)
* Business intelligence & reporting (Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, etc.)
* Microsoft Office applications (MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

title: Clinical Business Intelligence Manager
description:
**Clinical Business Intelligence Manager (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your deep expertise in healthcare analytics could directly influence how AI understands and reasons about clinical data? We're looking for an experienced Clinical Business Intelligence Manager to lead analytics work that sits at the intersection of healthcare intelligence and cutting-edge AI development.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for senior professionals who know how to turn complex clinical and operational data into decisions that matter. You'll bring your healthcare BI leadership experience to a team working on some of the most advanced AI projects in the industry.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and mentor a business intelligence team in building dashboards, reports, and analytics that support clinical and operational decision-making
* Design, maintain, and optimize BI infrastructure — including data models, SQL queries, and reporting pipelines — ensuring accuracy, reliability, and performance
* Analyze clinical, operational, and performance data to uncover meaningful trends and surface insights that support leadership decisions
* Translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, trusted outputs that drive improvements in care delivery and organizational efficiency
* Apply your domain expertise to evaluate, quality-check, and improve AI-generated outputs related to clinical analytics and healthcare data reasoning

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in healthcare or clinical analytics, business intelligence, or data management within regulated environments
* Proven track record designing and managing BI systems — including dashboards, reporting pipelines, and data models
* Comfortable working with clinical, operational, and administrative datasets and understanding their real-world implications
* Strong communicator who can translate technical findings into meaningful narratives for both clinical and operational stakeholders
* Self-directed and reliable — you deliver quality work independently without hand-holding

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM outputs, or AI training workflows
* Background in health informatics, population health, or value-based care analytics
* Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI platforms

**Why Join Us**

* Work alongside world-leading AI research labs on genuinely cutting-edge projects
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high-impact work
* Gain direct exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated
* Contribute clinical intelligence expertise to AI systems that will shape how healthcare data is understood at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Health Informatics Analyst
description:
**Health Informatics Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
We're looking for experienced Health Informatics Analysts to bring their clinical data expertise to cutting-edge AI development. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep knowledge of EHR systems, healthcare workflows, and data analysis will directly shape how AI understands and navigates the healthcare domain.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to apply your professional background in a flexible, remote freelance capacity while contributing to AI that could transform how healthcare information is processed and understood.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Analyze and interpret healthcare and EHR data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs related to clinical workflows, health information systems, and healthcare data pipelines for accuracy and quality
* Review and assess the correctness of AI responses to health informatics prompts, flagging errors, inconsistencies, or clinically unsafe recommendations
* Prepare structured feedback, ratings, and recommendations to help AI systems learn from real-world healthcare expertise
* Apply your knowledge of clinical and operational workflows to ensure AI outputs reflect accurate, real-world practice

**Who You Are**

* Hands-on experience working with healthcare data, EHR systems, or clinical reporting platforms
* Strong analytical skills including data interpretation, trend analysis, and reporting
* Ability to assess complex health information and communicate findings clearly
* Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on task-based assignments
* Detail-oriented, reliable, and thorough in your evaluations

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or evaluation frameworks
* Familiarity with health data standards such as HL7, FHIR, or ICD coding
* Background in clinical informatics, health IT, or population health analytics
* Prior exposure to AI tools or machine learning workflows

**Why Join Us**

* Work on meaningful AI projects with top-tier research labs and teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Put your specialized healthcare expertise to work in a high-impact, emerging field
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: AI Benchmark & Red-Teaming Specialist
description: About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.Role Overview:We are seeking an analytical researcher and red-teaming specialist to build evidence-based web-research benchmark tasks that reliably expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art (SOTA) AI models (e.g., Claude Opus 5 Max). In this role, you will discover hard-to-surface facts, build precise research tasks around them, test them directly against leading LLMs, and diagnose the exact failure mechanisms in the model's search and reasoning paths.Your work will directly shape AI evaluation frameworks, ensuring next-generation frontier models are tested against rigorous, non-trivial real-world research scenarios.Job Requirements:Core Experience: 1+ years in investigative research, fact-checking, AI benchmark task authoring, red-teaming, or technical QA review.Benchmark Familiarity: Proven experience authoring, testing, or reviewing tasks for AI benchmarks such as GAIA, BrowseComp, SimpleQA, SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, or Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE).Analytical & OSINT Skills: Intermediate-to-advanced web search and Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) skills; description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Data Scientist III, Analytics**
As a Data Scientist III, Analytics, you will independently lead analytical work that shapes decisions, improves performance, and scales better customer and business outcomes. You will combine technical expertise with business judgment to frame complex problems, develop robust analyses, and communicate clear recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
**Introduction to the Team**
The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.
  
  
This role sits within our analytics organization and supports post-booking servicing experiences. You will use data, experimentation, and analytical thinking to improve traveler outcomes, inform product decisions, and deliver measurable business impact in partnership with product, analytics, and leadership stakeholders.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead analytical projects or small work-streams from problem definition through recommendation, delivering insights that influence product and business decisions
* Extract, combine, and transform data from multiple sources to build reliable datasets for analysis, experimentation, and modeling
* Apply statistical methods, including regression, analysis of variance, hypothesis testing, and experiment design, to evaluate impact and solve business problems
* Use Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, R, or similar tools to analyze large datasets, develop scalable analytical approaches, and create clear visualisations
* Partner with subject matter experts and stakeholders to refine business questions, define success measures, and translate findings into practical recommendations
* Document analytical work, share reproducible code, and provide guidance and feedback that helps strengthen the analytics community

**Experience And Qualifications**

* You have a bachelor's degree, master's degree, or doctorate in mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics, engineering, or related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience

An orchestra of product managers, tech developers, designers, researchers, and revenue managers comes together to ensure we continue to lead and differentiate ourselves in the industry.

**About the role:**

As part of the GT Online Revenue function, you will join a whip-smart team responsible for managing revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability. You will embody our values of consumer focus, commitment to results, and continuous improvement by developing innovative solutions that raise challenging questions and demand both creative and practical answers.

The ideal candidate is an independent, self-starting, quick-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at cross-functional collaboration, blend creativity with strong organizational skills, manage deliverables under tight deadlines, and consistently produce high-quality work under pressure.

**What will you be doing**

* Own and manage the business P&L, working with internal stakeholders to devise strategies aimed at achieving revenue goals.

* Partner with product teams to develop first-class, customer-centric experiences.

* Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations through effective data interpretation and analysis.
* Integrate reporting components from multiple data sources to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Apply statistical methods to analyze data and answer key business questions, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Proven track record of working in high-growth, data-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.

* High energy, team-oriented, and brings a positive, can-do attitude.

* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Assistant Business Manager
description:

We are looking for an
**Assistant Business Manager**
to support the Business Manager in driving sales performance across stores. The role will focus on
**sales target achievement, performance analysis, identifying business gaps, and translating store-level data into actionable interventions**
.

The ideal candidate will be commercially driven, highly analytical and comfortable working closely with store teams to understand performance, identify opportunities and ensure execution against business priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Sales Performance & Target Achievement

* Support the Business Manager in driving achievement of
  **store and individual sales targets**
  .
* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance against targets, budgets and previous-period performance.
* Identify gaps in achievement and work with store teams to define corrective actions.
* Monitor performance by store, category, brand, product, salesperson and other relevant business parameters.

* Conversion rate
* Footfall and customer engagement
* Product/category contribution
* Individual salesperson performance

* Continuously innovate and improve existing models by integrating new data sources and advanced techniques to boost performance and scalability
* Collaborate closely with a team of experienced quantitative researchers to conduct experiments, backtest hypotheses, and refine strategies through rigorous simulations and data analysis

* BS/MS/PhD degree in any stem field
* 2+ years in a systematic trading environment
* Passion for machine learning
* Fluent with programming languages like Python

* Collaborative, Casual, and friendly work environment
* Health insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependents
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* Weekly company meals

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two-way communication.
* Plans required staffing levels to maintain required processes and procedures. Teams with HR and senior leadership to recruit, interview and hire employees.

Preferred

* Project management experience is desired, and a formal certification will be an added advantage
* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

This role is responsible for the accurate and timely production of tabulations, both interim and final, and requires close collaboration with research, project management, and scripting teams.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Running and validating interim and final tabulations (uncoded and coded) for quantitative research studies using relevant software (e.g., Q, Quantum, SPSS, Excel-based platforms, or proprietary tools).

* Assisting in preparing raw datasets for processing, including basic cleaning, formatting, and consistency checks.

* Liaising with scripting/programming team to ensure accurate data structure for tabulation.
* Working closely with the research and project management teams to understand project requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
* Providing input and feedback to internal stakeholders to optimise processes and outputs.
* Managing assigned tasks within deadlines and flag any delays or data issues proactively to the manager and wider team.
* Maintaining clear documentation of tabulation processes and version control.
* Support in updating project logs and workflow tracking systems.
* Continuously improving knowledge of data processing tools, tabulation best practices, and healthcare market research processes.

**What You'll Need**

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
**Data Science Lead – Churn & Retention Analytics | Microsoft Fabric / Azure ML**

**Location**
: Gurugram, Haryana, India (overlap with US Central Time required)

**Company**
: Neurogent.ai

**Employment Type**
: Full-time (Hybrid)

**Seniority**
: Senior / Lead

**Experience**
: 7+ years

**ABOUT NEUROGENT.AI:-**

Neurogent.ai builds agentic AI solutions, including AI agents, chatbots, and voice assistants, alongside data and ML platforms that automate workflows and improve customer experience across banking, healthcare, insurance, financial services, and multi-location consumer businesses.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:-**

We are looking for a senior,
**hands-on Data Science Lead specializing in Churn & Retention Analytics**
to join our delivery team working with a leading US early-education and childcare provider serving approximately 130,000 children across a workforce of 20,000 staff.

The client is building its
**data science capability on Microsoft Fabric**
, with student and family churn as the first approved use case.

The objective is to identify families at risk of withdrawal
**4–8 weeks before they leave,**
giving center directors enough time to intervene and improve retention.

Families often show early warning signs, such as declining attendance, reduced schedules, or changes in billing behavior. Your role will be to turn these signals into a reliable, explainable churn model that operations teams trust and use every week.

You will own the use case end-to-end, from defining churn and engineering features to building, deploying, and monitoring a production model that scores every active enrollment weekly.

This is both a technical leadership and business consulting role. You will work directly with US-based business leaders, the client's data science and IT teams, our onshore colleagues, and data engineers.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:-**

**1. Churn Analysis & Predictive Modeling**

• Define churn with business stakeholders, including withdrawal criteria, observation and prediction windows, and preventable versus unavoidable exits.

• Engineer behavioral features from attendance, enrollment, schedule changes, tenure, sibling status, age relative to kindergarten eligibility, and payment or billing patterns.

• Build and validate tabular churn models using XGBoost, LightGBM, gradient boosting, survival analysis, or time-to-event modeling.

• Calibrate risk scores and generate actionable risk rankings at the center level.

• Use SHAP and other explainability techniques to communicate why a family is flagged and recommend appropriate retention actions.

**2. Business Consulting & Stakeholder Management**

• Collaborate with US-based operations leaders, regional teams, corporate data science, and executive stakeholders to define business problems and success metrics.

• Translate model outputs into clear business insights, retention playbooks, and revenue-impact estimates.

• Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in a business-friendly manner.

• Challenge assumptions and requirements when necessary to ensure the solution drives measurable business outcomes.

**3. Data Quality & Feature Engineering**

• Partner with data engineering teams to integrate attendance, CRM, enrollment, and billing data into OneLake.

• Implement data-quality checks to identify source-system outages, missing attendance records, and other issues that could generate misleading churn signals.

• Establish safeguards to prevent model scoring when critical data-quality conditions are not met.

• Build reusable, versioned feature tables using Delta Lake to support future use cases, including teacher attrition.

**4. MLOps & Productionization – Microsoft Fabric / Azure**

• Develop and deploy ML solutions using Microsoft Fabric Notebooks, Python/R, Fabric Data Factory, OneLake Delta tables, and MLflow.

• Implement experiment tracking, model registry, versioning, and rollback mechanisms.

• Build reliable weekly batch-scoring pipelines for all active enrollments.

• Deliver ranked at-risk enrollment data to business users through Power BI dashboards using Direct Lake.

• Implement Dev/Test/Prod environments, Fabric deployment pipelines, and Azure DevOps CI/CD with approval gates.

• Manage secrets and dependencies using Azure Key Vault and pinned package environments.

• Establish monitoring for model drift, missing predictions, and data-quality failures, with alerts through Azure Monitor or Power Automate.

**5. Measurement & Experimentation**

• Design holdout and matched-control approaches to measure the effectiveness of retention outreach.

• Help distinguish genuine churn reduction from model accuracy alone.

• Contribute to experimentation initiatives involving matched control centers, difference-in-differences, effect sizes, and confidence intervals.

**6. Technical Leadership**

• Establish standards for reproducibility, code reviews, model reviews, documentation, and explainability.

• Mentor data scientists and engineers while collaborating with distributed client and delivery teams.

• Extend learnings from churn modeling to future use cases, including teacher attrition, occupancy and enrollment forecasting, and lead-to-enrollment scoring.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:-**

•
**7+ years of experience in data science or applied machine learning**
, including ownership of end-to-end ML outcomes in a senior or lead role.

• Proven
**hands-on experience in churn and retention analytics**
, including building and deploying models tied to measurable business results.

•
**Strong Azure data and ML experience is mandatory,**
with production ML delivery using Azure Machine Learning and/or Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory/Fabric Data Factory, and MLflow-style model lifecycle management.

• Advanced Python skills, including pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, and libraries such as lifelines or scikit-survival.

• Advanced SQL skills and working proficiency in R.

• Strong statistical foundations in survival analysis, model calibration, hypothesis testing, experimental design, and causal inference fundamentals.

• Practical MLOps experience covering Git, CI/CD for ML, batch-scoring pipelines, model monitoring, and drift detection.

• Experience delivering model outputs to business users through Power BI.

• Excellent communication skills and direct experience working with US-based clients and presenting to senior business stakeholders.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams with regular US Central Time overlap.

**NICE TO HAVE:-**

• Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience with OneLake, Lakehouse/Delta, Fabric Notebooks, deployment pipelines, and Direct Lake.

• Domain experience in childcare, education, healthcare, subscription businesses, or multi-location consumer services.

• Experience with workforce attrition modeling, time-series forecasting (Prophet/ARIMA), or lead scoring.

• Familiarity with quasi-experimental methods, including Dynamic Time Warping matching, difference-in-differences, and synthetic controls.

• Experience handling sensitive or child-related personal data under privacy regulations such as COPPA.

• Exposure to Databricks, AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure ML online endpoints.

• Consulting or professional services delivery experience.

• Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100), or Azure AI Engineer.

**WHY JOIN NEUROGENT.AI?**

•
**Own a high-impact enterprise ML use case**
: Lead a flagship churn prediction program with a clear, measurable business objective.

•
**Build from the ground up**
: Help establish a scalable data science and ML foundation on Microsoft Fabric.

•
**Influence business outcomes**
: Turn predictive insights into practical interventions that help improve family retention.

•
**Shape the roadmap**
: Extend your work into future applications such as teacher attrition, enrollment forecasting, and lead scoring.

•
**Take real ownership**
: Work in an AI-first environment with direct client exposure, technical leadership, and opportunities to influence product and delivery decisions.

**Interested in building ML solutions that deliver measurable business impact?**

Apply to join Neurogent.ai and help transform enterprise data into actionable decisions.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Description**
**The opportunity**
ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU.
  
  
You will be the first data scientist in our India team. At first, you will meet specialist teams, identify valuable use cases and build focused proofs of concept that demonstrate what data science and AI can do. As these relationships mature, you will help develop our ability to deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with the wider data science team from discovery through implementation. Knowledge of energy would help, initiative, technical breadth and the ability to earn trust across disciplines are central to the role.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Meet colleagues across practice areas to understand their work, identify specific use cases and agree what a useful result would look like.
* Initially, scope and demonstrate focused proofs of concept, choosing suitable methods from statistical analysis and forecasting to machine learning and language models.
* Explain methods, limitations and potential value clearly to specialists and nontechnical colleagues. Use their feedback to improve the solution and build confidence in the team’s services.
* Assess data quality, feasibility, privacy and delivery needs, and define the evidence needed to take a prototype further.
* As demand grows, design and deliver data science and AI solutions across projects with the wider team, from modelling and evaluation to integration, documentation and adoption. Contribute to proposals and client presentations.
* Establish reusable ways of working and help turn early demonstrations into a sustainable pipeline of well-defined client work.

**What You Will Bring**

* Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data.
* Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures.
* Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks.
* Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing.
* Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use.
* Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences.
* A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field.

**Useful Additional Experience**

* Experience in energy, utilities, climate or environmental policy, particularly applied analysis with domain experts.
* Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment.
* Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills.

**How We Work**
As the first data scientist in our India team, you will have the opportunity to shape how our established data science and AI services grow there. You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges, and see promising ideas develop into project work. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills.

Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

title: Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub
description:
**Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub**

**Engagement Type:**

Consultancy

**Location: New Delhi**

**LEAD’s**
**Gender x Digital (GxD) hub**
**is seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The role combines inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder coordination, with a focus on developing and operationalising frameworks, establishing inclusion metrics and monitoring systems, and building a coherent evidence base on programme inclusion.**
**About LEAD at Krea University**

LEAD
is an action-oriented research centre of IFMR Society (a not-for-profit society registered under the Societies Act), leverages the power of research, innovation and co-creation to solve complex and pressing challenges in development. LEAD specialises in developing in-depth granular understanding of socio-economic contexts and harnessing actionable insights that have a wide range of applications in industry, policy, and academia. LEAD is a collaborative hub that brings experts from diverse disciplines and sectors together to develop innovative solutions by harnessing innovation, technology and analytics.

**About GxD hub**

The
Gender x Digital hub (GxD hub)
is a cross-disciplinary platform dedicated to advancing meaningful digital connectivity among women and girls in India. GxD hub is an initiative of LEAD at Krea University (IFMR). Our mission is to address critical intersections between gender and digital through rigorous research, impactful engagement with stakeholders, and ecosystem development. Our work is rooted in a deep commitment to develop gender intentional and overall inclusive digital platforms in the country.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The candidate will sit at the intersection of inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder co-ordination, contributing to the development and operationalisation of frameworks that ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with a particular focus on women and underserved groups.

This role combines inclusion expertise with strong data capabilities. The candidate will be responsible for tracking and synthesising progress against inclusion targets, while building the systems and evidence base needed to document and communicate the programme’s equity outcomes across states and implementing partners.

This is a stakeholder-facing role for someone who can navigate government and field contexts while bringing analytical rigour to their work. The ideal candidate is an inclusion practitioner with strong data and research skills, who can synthesise evidence, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and translate programme insights into clear, actionable outputs. The candidate will be placed within the Ministry that GxD hub is closely working with.

**Key Responsibilities**



**Inclusion Strategy and Implementation**

●     Develop and operationalise an inclusion strategy to ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with attention to gender, geography, and socioeconomic status

●     Advise on accessibility standards for training content, digital platforms, and learning delivery mechanisms

●     Conduct periodic reviews and recommend interventions to address participation gaps across regions and demographics

**Monitoring, Data, and Evidence**

●     Establish inclusion metrics, monitoring frameworks, and reporting mechanisms for states and implementing partners

●     Ensure inclusion-related data is systematically collated, structured, and narrated consistently — building a coherent evidence base from the programme's earliest stages

●     Track and monitor progress on women's participation and other inclusion targets, and synthesise findings into regular reports and briefs for internal and external audiences

●     Support secondary data analysis and evidence synthesis to contextualise programme data within the broader landscape of digital inclusion in India

**Government and Stakeholder Coordination**

●     Coordinate with ministries, state governments, NGOs, and community organisations to improve outreach among underserved groups

**Minimum Qualifications**

●     Master's degree in Social Sciences, Gender Studies, Public Policy, Development Studies, Education, or a related field

●     Minimum 8 years of experience in inclusion, gender, accessibility, social development, or large-scale government or development programmes

●     Demonstrated experience working directly with central or state government counterparts in India — including in advisory, coordination, or embedded roles

●     Strong track record in data synthesis, evidence collation, and translating programme data into structured narratives for policy and funder audiences

●     Experience designing or operationalising inclusion monitoring frameworks, with hands-on familiarity with indicator development and reporting systems

**Strongly Desired**

●     Prior experience embedded in or advising large-scale government skilling, digital access.

●     Familiarity with India's digital ecosystem, including digital public infrastructure, and the policy landscape around AI and digital skilling

●     Experience working with government-commissioned research, and multi-stakeholder coordination across central and state bodies

●     Comfort with both qualitative and quantitative research methods, including primary data collection, field assessments, and mixed-method approaches

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

**hr-lead@ifmr.ac.in**
**:**

●     Curriculum vitae

They may also contribute to evidence-based technical guidance, protocols, standard operating procedures, training packages and implementation tools.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance is a major public health and development challenge in the WHO South-East Asia Region. Member States need timely, representative and quality-assured data on resistance patterns and antimicrobial use to guide national action plans, clinical and public health interventions, laboratory strategies, stewardship, infection prevention and control, and resource allocation.
  
  
Reliable laboratory systems are essential for effective AMR surveillance, including accurate bacterial and fungal identification, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, diagnostic stewardship, specimen referral, quality management and standardized data flows. WHO supports Member States, country offices and partners to strengthen sustainable surveillance and laboratory systems aligned with WHO standards and GLASS. This roster will help WHO SEARO identify specialists for time-bound regional or country assignments based on emerging needs.
  
  
**Deliverables**
Under The Overall Guidance Of WHO Technical Unit, Consultants May Be Requested To Perform One Or More Of The Following Assignments (a More Specific Terms Of Reference (TORs), Including The Exact Deliverables, Duration Of Assignment And Place Of Assignment Will Be Shared With The Selected Candidate At The Time Of Hiring For a Specific Assignment):
  
  
****Deliverable 1: Surveillance and laboratory assessment.****
Conduct desk or country assessment of AMR surveillance systems, data flows, governance arrangements, indicators, data quality, bacteriology and mycology capacity, laboratory networks, diagnostic stewardship and reporting processes, with prioritized and feasible recommendations
  
  
****Deliverable 2: Technical products and implementation tools.****
Design assignment-specific protocols, standard operating procedures, data dictionaries, validation checklists, surveillance tools, indicator frameworks, laboratory-strengthening plans, survey materials, diagnostic-stewardship tools, guidance documents or One Health implementation products
  
  
****Deliverable 3: Data and analytical outputs.****
Develop cleaned or validated datasets; statistical, microbiological or genomic analyses; reproducible code or pipelines; tables, figures, maps, dashboards or visualization specifications; interpretation notes; and quality documentation, as applicable
  
  
****Deliverable 4: Laboratory and diagnostic products.****
Adapt guidance documents, training packages and tools for clinical bacteriology and mycology; laboratory quality management; antimicrobial susceptibility testing; external quality assurance; specimen referral; laboratory networks; and diagnostic stewardship.
  
  
****Deliverable 5: Capacity-development package.****
Develop training needs findings, curricula, presentations, exercises, job aids, workshop or webinar facilitation, mentoring records and a brief evaluation of learning and follow-up needs.
  
  
****Deliverable 6: Reporting and knowledge products.****
Prepare GLASS submission-related outputs, national or regional surveillance reports, laboratory-capacity reports, policy briefs, technical reports, manuscripts, systematic reviews, presentations or other communication products.

**Qualifications, experience, skills and languages**
**Essential:**
**Band level B:**
A first university degree or medical degree in epidemiology, public health, medicine, clinical microbiology, laboratory sciences, biostatistics, statistics, mathematical modelling, health informatics, data science, computer science, bioinformatics, veterinary public health, environmental health, pharmacy, health economics or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
**Band level C:**
An advanced university degree or medical degree with postgraduate specialization in one of the fields listed above or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
Desirable: Additional postgraduate training, specialization or professional certification relevant to the technical profile, such as clinical microbiology, bacteriology, mycology, field epidemiology, laboratory quality management, diagnostic stewardship, data analytics, geographic information systems, genomic epidemiology, health information systems, monitoring and evaluation, or adult learning.
  
  
****Experience****
Essential
  
  
Band level B: At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the technical profiles advertised.
  
  
**Band Level C:**

* Mycological diagnosis, diagnostic stewardship or laboratory quality management.

Desirable

* Experience working with ministries of health, national AMR programmes, public health institutes, reference laboratories, academic institutions or One Health coordination mechanisms.
* Experience in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in the WHO South-East Asia Region.
