title: Senior Analyst, PPK Operations
description:
**Company Overview**
Bain & Company is the management consulting firm that the world's business leaders come to when they want results. Bain advises clients on strategy, operations, information technology, organization, private equity, digital transformation and strategy, and mergers and acquisitions, developing practical insights that clients act on and transferring skills that make change stick. The firm aligns its incentives with clients by linking its fees to their results. Bain clients have outperformed the stock market 4 to 1. Founded in 1973, Bain has 58 offices in 37 countries, and its deep expertise and client roster cross every industry and economic sector.
  
  
**Department Overview**
Bain's Product, Practice & Knowledge (PPK) department has played a vital role in harnessing the best of our consulting staffs' individual and collective expertise for over 20 years. Within PPK, each practice supports teams across the globe with deep expertise and knowledge. Our practices play a critical role in Bain's commercial success and are a key strategic priority.
  
  
PPK is continually focused on creating a stronger, more scalable, efficient and effective PPK organization. The PPK Operations team will help achieve this by developing and improving processes, tools, and communications to better support our PPK teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Senior Analyst is a technical builder on the PPK Operations team. Where the Analyst supports defined analytical workstreams and the Operations Manager owns the simplification agenda end to end, this role sits between the two: it takes ownership of complete solutions from problem definition through build and adoption, working with limited supervision, and is expected to bring the technical depth that makes automation and AI-enabled delivery real.
  
  
The distinguishing expectation of this role is speed of build. We are looking for someone who uses AI tools and low-code platforms to deliver dashboards, automations and analyses in a fraction of the time traditional approaches require, and who can explain and defend the logic behind what they build.
  
  
**Automation and AI-enabled solution build (~40%)**

* Designs and builds automated solutions that remove manual effort from recurring PPK processes, using Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel and scripting as appropriate
* Uses AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT as a core part of the build workflow to accelerate development, generate and debug code and formulas, structure unfamiliar data, and prototype solutions quickly
* Prototypes and deploys AI agents and assistants for defined PPK use cases; identifies where an agentic approach outperforms a conventional one
* Translates business requirements into working logic: data flows, conditional rules, error handling and validation, so solutions hold up in production and not only in demo
* Documents what is built so solutions can be maintained, handed over and reused across practices
* Maintains a healthy skepticism about AI output, validating results before they inform decisions or reach stakeholders

**Operations project delivery (~30%)**

* Owns discrete PPK Operations workstreams from scoping through delivery, with the Operations Manager as thought partner rather than reviewer of every step
* Contributes to the PPK Operations project backlog by identifying candidates, sizing effort and impact, and recommending sequencing
* Engages internal stakeholders directly to gather requirements, clarify scope, secure inputs and drive adoption of what is delivered
* Runs test and learn pilots, captures what worked and what did not, and folds those lessons into the next build
* Proactively flags gaps, dependencies and tradeoffs rather than waiting to be asked

**Analytics and reporting (~20%)**

* Builds and owns Power BI dashboards end to end, covering data modelling, DAX, Power Query and visual design, applying Bain visual standards
* Rebuilds and streamlines existing reporting so recurring outputs run with minimal manual intervention
* Performs quantitative analysis on PPK operational data and derives insights that stand on their own rather than only presenting the numbers
* Triangulates data across multiple systems and stakeholders, resolving inconsistencies and flagging data quality issues at source
* Produces insight-driven output in the right format for the audience, whether a dashboard, a deck, a model or a written recommendation

**Teaming and apprenticeship (10%)**

* Coaches junior analysts on technical craft, including tool selection, prompt design, dashboard structure and automation hygiene
* Reviews the technical quality of work produced by others on the team and raises the standard through direct, constructive feedback
* Shares reusable assets, templates and best practices across PPK so solutions built once are used many times
* Evangelizes the art of the possible to other teams and builds credibility for new ways of working through demonstrated results
* Contributes as a member of the broader PPK community through projects, training and experience sharing

**About You**
**Technical skills: required**

* Practical, daily working fluency with AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT, used to build and ship real deliverables rather than to draft text; you can point to work that was materially faster or better because of how you used them
* Strong Power BI capability including data modelling, DAX and Power Query, with the ability to take a dashboard from raw data to a stakeholder-ready product without handoffs
* Working knowledge of programming, in any language, sufficient that logic building is second nature: you understand data structures, control flow, functions and debugging, and can read, adapt and reason about code even where you do not write production software
* Advanced Excel, including complex formulas, structured data handling and comfort with large or messy datasets
* Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to structure a clear argument, not only format slides

**Technical skills: preferred**

* Experience across the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly Power Automate, SharePoint lists and libraries, and Power Apps
* Experience building AI agents or assistants, including prompt engineering, tool and API integration, and evaluating agent output
* Process automation experience of any kind, whether scripted, low-code or RPA based, with a track record of removing recurring manual work
* Python or a comparable scripting language for data manipulation, API work and automation
* Familiarity with APIs and how systems exchange data; comfort reading documentation and working out an integration independently
* Exposure to Alteryx, Tableau or comparable analytics and data preparation tools

**Experience And Mindset**

* 4 to 6 years of experience in a professional services, consulting, analytics, knowledge management or operations environment
* Demonstrated ownership of solutions end to end, from ambiguous problem statement through to a working, adopted product
* A self-learner with a genuine desire to figure it out; you pick up new tools quickly and without being taught
* A passion for changing how work gets done by adopting new approaches and new technology, paired with the judgement to know when the traditional approach is still the right one
* Structured problem-solving: you break ambiguous questions into clear hypotheses, analyses and implications
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical choices to a non-technical audience and establish credibility with senior stakeholders
* The maturity and integrity to handle confidential information and to use technology, including AI, responsibly
* Ability to operate independently, comfortable with a remote supervisor and wider team, managing competing priorities with minimal supervision
* Known for high-quality work, attentive to detail and well-organized
* Bachelor of Arts, Engineering, Science or equivalent undergraduate degree with strong academic credentials; Statistics, Business, Economics, Computer Science or Analytics concentrations also applicable

title: Head - Data M&E & Institutional Intelligence
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk operates on the principle that 'what gets measured, gets governed.' This role owns the data spine of the organisation — the independent control room that tells every layer of RightWalk whether systems are working, outcomes are real, and learning is being captured. Critically, this function must be independent of the program teams whose performance it measures. Data inflation and incentive-driven reporting are existential threats to RightWalk's credibility. The Head – Data, M&E & Institutional Intelligence is the institutional conscience of the organisation's evidence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Data and indicator architecture**

* Design and own the end-to-end data architecture: from field input to impact indicators — definitions, collection protocols, validation logic, and storage.
* Build common data dictionaries across programs and states.
* Ensure indicator definitions are clear, auditable and usable by teams.
* Align program indicators with donor reporting, government dashboards and internal learning needs.

**2. Dashboards and institutional intelligence**

* Build and maintain real-time dashboards and standard report packs for the CEO, state teams, and donors.
* Drive institutional intelligence: cross-state comparisons, learning loops, and evidence synthesis for policy refinement.
* Convert data into actionable intelligence for policy, program and product decisions.
* Manage the Knowledge Management function — evidence library, document repositories, and institutional memory.

**3. M&E systems and quality assurance**

* Lead the M&E framework: indicator design, sampling methodology, periodic evaluation cycles, and external evaluation partnerships.
* Own data governance — data quality audits, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag dashboards, and anomaly detection.
* Lead and develop State M&E Leads (embedded in states, functionally reporting to this role).
* Conduct periodic verification, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag reviews and quality audits.
* Maintain strict independence from Program and State teams — this role's credibility depends on it.

**4. Learning loops and evidence building**

* Ensure field learning feeds into policy redesign, process improvement and product updates.
* Support impact evaluation readiness and external evaluation partnerships.
* Produce public-good outputs — impact reports, evidence briefs, and external publications that build RightWalk's credibility.

**5. Data governance and ethics**

* Define data access, privacy, anonymisation and data security protocols with Tech and People teams.
* Ensure responsible handling of beneficiary, field and government data.
* Create data discipline without making teams feel they are entering a tax raid.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — SIX MONTHS**

* Organisation-wide M&E and data architecture drafted and adopted.
* A live dashboard exists that the CEO, State Directors, and donors can access — real-time, reliable, and action-oriented.
* Data quality audits are conducted every quarter; anomalies are surfaced, not suppressed.
* The organisation makes at least two key program design changes in direct response to M&E evidence.
* RightWalk publishes at least one credible external evidence brief that strengthens its policy positioning.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Setting programmatic targets — that is the program team's domain.
* Managing field delivery or GDN operations.
* Policy authorship or advocacy strategy.
* Tech platform development (though close collaboration with Tech is essential).
* Sit under state programs whose performance it must assess.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Experience:**
  10–16 years in M&E, data systems, evaluation, or research — ideally within development sector, government advisory, or research institutions.
* **Methods:**
  Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills — comfortable with both survey-based M&E and systems-level data architecture.
* **Tools:**
  Experience with MIS/dashboard design and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* **Independence:**
  Track record of building independent M&E functions that are trusted by leadership and donors alike.
* **Orientation:**
  Governance mindset - more interested in data integrity than in making numbers look good.
* **Sector:**
  Exposure to government data systems, HMIS, DISE, or similar public data infrastructure

**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO South-East Asia Regional Office (SEARO) seeks to establish a roster of qualified consultants to provide technical support to Member States in strengthening antimicrobial stewardship, improving access to quality-assured antimicrobials, optimizing antimicrobial use, strengthening pharmaceutical governance and regulatory systems, monitoring antimicrobial consumption, and implementing One Health approaches to address antimicrobial resistance.
  
  
Selected consultants may be engaged to support regional and country-level activities aligned with the Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance, the 2024 United Nations General Assembly Political Declaration on AMR, the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, WHO AWaRe guidance, Universal Health Coverage goals, national AMR action plans, and relevant WHO guidance, standards and toolkits on antimicrobial use surveillance, antimicrobial stewardship, equitable access to quality-assured antimicrobials, and responsible antimicrobial use across human health and One Health contexts.
  
  
**Background**
AMR continues to threaten public health and health system resilience across the WHO South-East Asia Region. Despite progress in implementing national action plans, countries continue to face challenges in responsible antimicrobial use, equitable access to quality-assured antimicrobials, stewardship capacity, AMU surveillance, regulatory oversight and pharmaceutical governance. Strengthening AWaRe implementation, stewardship programmes, surveillance systems and One Health collaboration remains a regional priority under the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025–2030. A roster of technical experts will help WHO rapidly support Member States with specialized expertise as needs arise.
  
  
**Deliverables**
Under the overall guidance of the WHO technical unit, consultants may be requested to perform one or more of the following assignments. A more specific Terms of Reference, including exact deliverables, duration, and place of assignment, will be issued at the time of contracting.
  
  
**Deliverable 1: Antimicrobial Use (AMU) Surveillance and Analytics**
Establish or strengthen AMU surveillance systems, including methods, protocols, data collection, analysis, reporting, dashboards, multisectoral integration, and technical recommendations.
  
  
**Deliverable 2: Antimicrobial Stewardship Programme Development and Implementation**
Develop and implement AMS strategies, programmes, tools and quality-improvement measures, including AWaRe implementation and interventions to improve prescribing practices.
  
  
**Deliverable 3: Access to Antimicrobials and Shortage Management**
Assess antimicrobial availability, affordability, accessibility, quality, shortages, procurement and supply-chain systems, and develop strategies to improve access, prevent stockouts, strengthen supply security, and ensure equitable access to essential antibiotics.
  
  
**Deliverable 4: Regulatory Systems and Pharmaceutical Governance**
Review antimicrobial regulatory and policy frameworks, assess prescribing, dispensing, sales and marketing practices, and support stronger regulations, quality assurance, licensing, prescription-only policies and implementation recommendations.
  
  
**Deliverable 5: One Health Antimicrobial Use Optimization**
Support One Health approaches to optimize antimicrobial use across human, animal, food production and environmental sectors, including multisectoral coordination, integrated monitoring, consultations, and implementation of responsible-use strategies and action plans.
  
  
**Deliverable 6: Capacity Development**
Develop and deliver AMS/AMU training, mentoring, awareness and behaviour-change activities, and strengthen institutional capacity for stewardship, surveillance, regulation and access programmes.
  
  
**Deliverable 7: Monitoring, Evaluation and Programme Performance Assessment**
Monitor and evaluate AMS, AMU, access and governance programmes, including indicators, reporting systems, performance reviews, lessons learned and recommendations for strengthening and sustainability.

title: Geospatial Intelligence Analyst
description:
**Role Highlights**

* Role: Geospatial Intelligence Analyst
* Department: ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance)
* Location: New Delhi, India
* Reports to: Operations Lead, ISR Analytics
* Working type: Hybrid
* Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

The Mission of the Geospatial Intelligence Analyst
  
  
As Geospatial Intelligence Analyst, you will be the bridge between ICEYE's world-leading SAR satellite data and the defence and intelligence customers who depend on it to make mission-critical decisions. Your core work is transforming complex radar and electro-optical imagery into precise, timely intelligence reports and operational insights — applying rigorous imagery intelligence tradecraft to answer real questions in high-stakes environments. Beyond the analysis itself, you will brief VIP and expert audiences, train customer teams to independently harness ICEYE's capabilities, and collaborate with product and engineering teams to shape the next generation of ISR tools and workflows.
  
  
Who are we?
  
  
ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.
  
  
As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, Germany, and the US. The company has more than 900 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.
  
  
**Day To Day Responsibilities**

* Conduct SAR and EO imagery interpretation.
* Deliver analysis outputs and intelligence reports for defence & intelligence users.
* Conduct briefings and demonstrations to VIPs and expert audiences alike.
* Train, and enable customers to independently use ICEYE’s systems and analytical tools.
* Contribute to ISR product development by implementing new analysis, dissemination. and integration workflows in collaboration with product and engineering teams.

**Requirements**
Must have skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in relevant fields (e.g. geography, geoinformatics, military studies).
* Strong geospatial foundation; experience in e.g. QGIS, ArcGIS.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced operational environment as part of a tightly-nit team in field deployments.
* Excellent communication, social, and presentation skills; comfortable with diverse and senior audiences.
* Experience in SAR and EO imagery interpretation or experience in GEONT, IMINT disciplines highly desirable.
* Comfortable working under pressure, on-site, and during prolonged deployments.
* Experience in military or defense sectors is strongly preferred.
* Subject matter expertise in naval, ground or air domains highly desirable.
* Programming (Python) and utilizing AI/ML frameworks to develop applications.
* Team player with a good sense of humor.
* High integrity and resiliency, strong ownership, and continuous learning mindset.

Nice to have skills
  
  

* Fluent in English.
* Ability to travel frequently and sometimes on short notice.
* Geospatial / ISR expertise required; either geospatial or intelligence foundations must be strong
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Application process
  
  

* Talent Acquisition Interview
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Technical Interview (onsite or virtual), including a Technical Challenge
* Hiring Team Interview
* Offer Decision

Working at ICEYE
  
  
At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.
  
  
How We Work (Our Values)
  
  
**Make the impossible possible:**
We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
  
  

* Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
* See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
* Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
* Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
* Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

**Benefits**
Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing—at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.
  
  
Our commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
  
  
We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.
  
  
We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.
  
  
Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com

**Area of expertise**
Roster of International consultant – Strategic planning, costing, monitoring, and evaluation for antimicrobial resistance (AMR).
  
  
**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO South-East Asia Regional Office (SEARO) seeks to establish a roster of qualified consultants to provide technical support to Member States in the development, implementation, costing, monitoring, evaluation, review, and strengthening of National Action Plans (NAPs) on Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR).
  
  
Selected consultants may be engaged to support regional and country-level activities aligned with the Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance, the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, and the One Health approach.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) remains a major threat to public health, food security, economic development, and health system resilience. Countries in the WHO South-East Asia Region have developed and are implementing National Action Plans on AMR; however, varying levels of capacity, financing, governance, monitoring systems, and multisectoral coordination continue to challenge effective implementation.
  
  
To support Member States in strengthening AMR national programmes and advancing implementation of the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, WHO requires a roster of technical experts capable of providing specialized support across strategic planning, costing, resource mobilization, monitoring and evaluation, programme review, governance strengthening, and One Health coordination.
  
  
The roster will enable WHO to rapidly mobilize qualified experts to support national and regional priorities as needs arise.

**Deliverable 1: National Action Plan Development and Revision**

* Conduct situational and strategic analyses.
* Facilitate stakeholder consultations and multisectoral engagement.
* Develop or update AMR National Action Plans.
* Prepare implementation frameworks and operational plans.
* Support national validation and endorsement processes.

**Deliverable 2: Costing, Budgeting and Financing**

* Develop costed implementation plans.
* Conduct budget and financing analyses.
* Estimate resource requirements and investment needs.
* Develop financing scenarios and sustainability plans.
* Prepare resource mobilization strategies and investment cases.
* Assess cost-saving potential, cost-effectiveness and return on investment for AMR interventions and implementation options.

**Deliverable 3: Monitoring, Evaluation and Accountability Frameworks**

* Design logical frameworks and performance indicators.

* Develop accountability and learning frameworks.
* Design data collection and review tools

**Deliverable 4: Mid-Term and End-Term Reviews**

* Analyse implementation progress and bottlenecks.
* Produce review reports and recommendations.

**Deliverable 5: Capacity Development**

* Strengthen national capacity in planning, costing, monitoring and evaluation.

**Deliverable 6: Reporting and Policy Products**

* Produce national and regional assessment reports.
* Develop strategic planning and investment documents.

title: Associate, AI Model Validation, RQA
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Overview**
The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks.  RQA’s principal objectives are to advance the firm’s risk management practices and to deliver independent risk expertise and constructive challenge to drive better business and investment outcomes.
  
  
RQA is committed to investing in our people to increase individual enablement and ultimately build a stronger team. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages collaboration, innovation, diversity and the development our future leaders.  We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strength connect with our purpose.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Enterprise Risk team within RQA oversees those risks which directly impact the corporate entity (i.e. BlackRock, Inc., or one of its subsidiaries), rather than the fiduciary risks assumed by funds/clients, such as investment risks and counterparty risks. The team’s focus includes but is not limited to operational risk, technology, vendor, model and market risk, stress testing for market risk and the quantitative estimation of capital adequacy requirements.
  
  
The
**AI Validation**
Associate will perform independent reviews of AI tools and agents used across BlackRock, including agentic systems, RAG applications and other business workflows. This role requires strong technical expertise combined with risk management skills to challenge system design, data integrity, and performance monitoring. The role will be based onsite in our GGN office.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct independent validation of AI usage in workflows, including testing for accuracy, efficiency of guardrails, orchestration, memory management and token usage.
* Design and implement comprehensive validation strategies and test plans tailored to each AI use case. Define clear success criteria and quality benchmarks to measure whether the AI solution meets all requirements and standards.
* Understand tool architecture, potential vulnerabilities and weaknesses.
* Assess conceptual soundness, methodology, and alignment with intended business use.
* Review data quality, preprocessing steps and engineering decisions for AI use cases.
* Execute functional and performance tests.
* Evaluate performance metrics, robustness, and limitations under various scenarios.
* Document validation findings, provide recommendations
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies, validation techniques, and regulatory developments.
* Communicate validation conclusions to relevant stakeholders, including escalating identified findings, risks or gaps to senior leadership and approval committees
* Collaborate with AI Engineering, Data Science, and Risk teams to enhance AI transparency and trustworthiness.

**Experience, Skills And Qualification**

* With 3-7 years’ works experience in the IT or financial industry.
* Degree or Advanced degree (MS, PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
* Strong understanding of generative AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, prompt engineering, tool use, and modern AI application architectures.
* Experience with Python and common AI development libraries and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar).
* Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and challenge stakeholders constructively.
* Experience with one or more of the following:
* Validating usage of large language models (LLMs) in business context
* Evaluation methodologies, benchmark development, ground-truth creation, and AI quality assessment
* AI observability, monitoring, performance measurement, and operational controls
* AI orchestration frameworks, agent architectures, prompt engineering, memory management, and context optimization
* Exposure to cloud-based AI platforms and scalable model deployment
* MCP, APIs, connectors and integrations of AI solutions with enterprise systems and data sources
* Responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, bias assessment, transparency, and model governance
* Fine-tuning or model customization techniques
* Security testing and risk assessment of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreak, and data leakage testing

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**

**What You Will Do**
Based in India, the Associate Manager, Integrated Modeling Solutions will develop, test, enhance, and deliver components of Prudential's proprietary PyVal liability engine and Eureka! integrated modeling application. This hands-on role brings together modern software development with actuarial, finance, investment, and risk expertise to support valuation, forecasting, capital management, asset liability management, and strategic decision-making across multiple businesses and jurisdictions.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Develop, configure, test, and maintain Python-based financial and actuarial modeling capabilities within PyVal and Eureka!, translating business requirements into reliable, scalable, and reusable solutions.
* Implement new products, assumptions, methodologies, scenarios, reporting needs, and forecasting capabilities while applying version control, peer review, modular design, coding standards, and disciplined deployment practices.
* Perform unit, integration, regression, sensitivity, and reconciliation testing; investigate model results, data issues, and defects; and drive issues through resolution.
* Maintain clear documentation of model logic, assumptions, data flows, controls, test results, limitations, and change history in line with model governance and risk standards.
* Partner across Actuarial, Finance, Investments, Treasury, Risk, Technology, and business teams, contributing to Agile delivery, reusable standards, automation, and continuous improvement.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Five or more years of relevant experience in actuarial modeling, financial modeling, quantitative analysis, risk, software development, or a related discipline.
* Strong hands-on Python proficiency, including development of well-structured, testable, and maintainable code.
* Experience developing, testing, validating, or operating financial, actuarial, risk, or projection models.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated effectiveness across global, cross-functional teams.

**What will set you apart?**

* Progress toward an Associate or Fellow credential from a recognized actuarial body, or toward CFA, FRM, or an equivalent quantitative credential.
* Experience in insurance or reinsurance, including life insurance, annuities, retirement, or institutional products.
* Knowledge of valuation, financial planning and analysis, capital modeling, liquidity risk, economic capital, or asset liability management.
* Exposure to US GAAP, US statutory reporting, Bermuda EBS or BSCR, or other insurance accounting and regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with Git, cloud computing, automated testing, continuous integration, data pipelines, or Agile delivery.
* Experience with Prophet, MoSes, or comparable projection systems.

title: ML AI Intern
description:
**ML / AI Engineer Intern**

**Location:**

Gurgaon, India (On-site Role)

**Type:**

Full-time Internship (6 - 12  Months) | Paid

**Eligibility:**

Students graduating in 2027 (B.Tech / B.E. CSE, EE, AI/ML, or related)

 

 
**About JoshTalks AI**

At JoshTalks AI, we believe voice will become the primary interface between humans and machines. We build benchmarks, datasets, and AI systems that power some of the world's most widely used speech models.

**Our mission:**

• Enable machines to communicate as naturally as humans

• Build benchmarks and datasets that form the backbone of global speech AI progress

• Drive improvements through high-quality, diverse, real-world data — not just compute

 

 
**What You'll Work On**

*This is not a conventional internship. You will directly contribute to work that influences the global speech AI ecosystem.*

**Data Delivery (Cloud & Containers)**

• Deliver processed speech and audio datasets via cloud-based container pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Design and manage end-to-end data delivery workflows  from raw ingestion to structured output

• Build and maintain ETL pipelines to prepare data for model training and evaluation at scale

• Ensure reliable, versioned, and reproducible data handoffs to ML training infrastructure

• Monitor pipeline health, resolve bottlenecks, and optimize throughput for large-scale data movement

 

**Benchmarking & Evaluation**

• Design and run evaluations for ASR and speech-to-speech systems

• Benchmark leading speech models to identify real-world strengths, weaknesses, and failure modes

• Build evaluation frameworks that guide top AI labs on model performance and improvement areas

 

**Modeling & Fine-Tuning**

• Fine-tune speech recognition models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec2) targeting Word Error Rates of ~5%

• Experiment with multilingual, code-switched, accented, and noisy speech data

• Work with large-scale, production-grade speech datasets across 20+ Indian languages

 

**Who We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

• Students in t B.Tech/B.E. graduating in 2027 (CSE, EE, AI/ML, or related fields)

• Strong interest in speech, audio, NLP, or multimodal AI

• Hands-on experience in one or more of the following:

◦ Fine-tuning speech or language models (Whisper, wav2vec2, HuBERT, etc.)

◦ Building speech-driven pipelines, classifiers, or assistants

◦ Working with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers

◦ Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container tools (Docker, Kubernetes)

 

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Open-source contributions, GitHub projects, Kaggle experience, 

• Experience with multilingual or low-resource speech data

• Familiarity with ETL workflows, data versioning (DVC, MLflow), or orchestration (Airflow, Prefect)

title: Quality Insights Lead

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
The Quality Insights Lead (QIL) supports the daily operations of the Quality program, setting a high standard for quality across the Customer Support (CS) organization. Reporting to the Quality Manager, the QIL drives continuous improvement through Quality initiatives, including analysis, business case development, reporting on Quality monitoring, and applying Problem Solving Methodologies. They ensure all assigned tasks are completed on time, collaborate with other CS teams as the Quality representative, and may oversee Quality Partner sites as needed. The QIL also serves as a brand ambassador, upholding exceptional customer service standards.

* Provide daily support for Quality programs.

* Convert machine-generated insights from AI-assisted monitoring into strategic service enhancements and targeted coaching priorities.

title: Databricks and Risk Application Production Support Lead
description:

Gurgaon, Haryana, India
  
  
The role exists to ensure stable, secure, cost-efficient, and predictable operations (BAU) of the GRM application ecosystem connected to GDP (Global Data Platform), with a good focus on Databricks as the execution and industrialization engine. The role holder will act as production support lead (and operational engineering owner) across Databricks workloads, data pipelines, and app components, while contributing occasionally to strategic projects.
  
  
What you’ll be DOING
  
  
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  
End-to-end BAU (Run) responsibility for the GRM risk tooling ecosystem leveraging Microsoft Azure / Databricks, including:
  
  

* Natural Event Platform application landscape (run + operational support)
* STEC application landscape (run + operational support)

This role includes involvement in some punctual projects needing good Databricks skills.
  
  
You will report to be defined – GRM Tech Owner / Run Manager).
  
  
What you will BRING
  
  
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**- BAU / Run operations ownership (core mission)

- Maintain/operate data quality controls relevant to the application ecosystem
- Project support (punctual contribution)
- Provide hands-on engineering support to project initiatives when needed (capacity-based), including:

* Notus modernization / recoding / migration activities (e.g., the confirmed move from Azure Batch to Databricks in GDP; PoC/benchmark contributions; industrialization work).
* Contributions to GDP-connected initiatives under the GRM governance streams (Natural Event Platform, Solvency 2 Internal Model and related technical excellence tracks).
* Participate in design reviews to ensure “build-to-run” quality: operability, monitoring, cost guardrails, and documentation before production release.
* Stakeholder management & governance rhythm
* Act as the operational focal point for GRM and platform stakeholders, participating in governance/rituals (initiative reviews, risk follow-ups) as required.
* Provide clear communication on incidents, risks, dependencies, and operational improvements.

**Specialist Skills & Experience (must-have)**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* good hands-on expertise with Databricks in production contexts (workflows/jobs scheduling, cluster policies, libraries, notebooks, troubleshooting).
* Advanced PySpark and SQL skills for investigation and remediation of data and pipeline issues.
* Experience with production support for data platforms/app ecosystems (L2/L3).

Run/Service Management
  
  

* Proven experience operating services under SLA/OLA constraints: incident/problem/change management, runbooks, operational reporting.

Cost / Performance / Reliability
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to manage compute cost, performance tuning, and reliability improvements—particularly relevant for scalable run workloads

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Experience in cloud data platforms and enterprise data governance constraints (access management, secure data handling).
* Familiarity with integration patterns (API management, managed file transfer approaches) in data exchange ecosystems.
* Exposure to risk modeling / catastrophe modeling application contexts (helpful but not required).

Key interfaces (who the role works with)
  
  

* GRM Tech & Product stakeholders (application owners, BAU owners, governance leads) across Natural Event Platform, STEC apps
* AXA GO, mainly GDP & CFGP teams (engineering) but as well transversal GO families such as security, access management, architecture supporting the platform releases and readiness.
* Project teams during transformations

Success measures (KPIs / outcomes)
  
  

* High service stability: reduced incident volume, improved MTTR, fewer recurring problems.
* Operational readiness: complete runbooks, monitoring coverage, predictable release transitions.
* Cost and performance control: measurable improvements in compute cost monitoring and optimization (especially on Notus run consumption).
* Stakeholder satisfaction (derived from the three criteria above): clear communication, reliable support, proactive risk management.

Working model (ESS – India)
  
  

* Coverage aligned to GRM needs.
* On call / extended support windows if required during major releases or critical incidents.

Who WE are
  
  
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
What we OFFER
  
  
Inclusion
  
  
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.

**About The Role.**
The Sensory Scientist reports to the Sensory UX Innovation Manager, Asia Pacific and South African (APACSA) and is based in Delhi, India.
  
  
This role applies sensory and consumer/customer research best practices and methodologies, to provide guidance and insights to McCain’s regional and local Product Development teams throughout the stage gate process.
  
  
This position is a key member of a Asia Pacific and South African (APACSA) regional Sensory UX team and provides direction and training to various stakeholders on all sensory aspects of McCain’s products. Sensory Scientist partners with cross-functional teams to integrate sensory practices and testing, where appropriate, throughout the product development process.
  
  
The role is responsible for using and creating sensory Consumer/customer and analytical methods to guide product development, enable successful innovation launches and guide renovation efforts. The Sensory Scientist designs and leads testing plans with scientific rigor, issues reports and creates actionable recommendations to stakeholders.
  
  
The Sensory Scientist collaborates with R&D, Marketing, Consumer Insights, Operations, and other internal and external partners on new products, processes, quality improvements and cost savings to drive McCain’s profitable growth.
  
  
As part of the Global Sensory and User Experience team, the Sensory Scientist also works with internal team members to expand McCain’s global sensory capabilities. This includes the optimization and standardization of sensory tools and the development of new or hybrid methods. It also includes developing new training materials, assessing and onboarding new vendors, identifying and closing gaps the company has in regard to its sensory needs, and contributing to investigations regarding the linkage between sensory methods or attribute intensities to instrumental test methods.
  
  
The position executes and reports sensory and consumer/customer research studies. As such, the Sensory Scientist builds and maintains strong relationships with core vendors, supervises the application of best scientific practices by such vendors and manages test costs and timelines.
  
  
This position is based in the McCain HO. Ad hoc travel to regional plants and research venues (including Research Agency sites, Universities etc) may be required (eg for product tastings/review and other R&D focused activities as required). McCain will reimburse travel costs for such work-related travel
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* Partners with Consumer Insights, Research and Development, Marketing, Packaging, Supply Chain, and other business and product teams to guide the optimization of innovation products, product improvements, and define product quality as part of building consumer led specifications.
* Drives projects through appropriate product and packaging consumer/customer and sensory learning plans from optimization to confirmatory testing, inclusive of building foundational product knowledge, protecting product quality, and enhancing consumer/customer understanding.
* Facilitates consumer/customer interactions to grow consumer/customer empathy. Examples of this include meetings with Customers to review and define product development briefs and sensory review of stimulus, as well as leveraging any consumer/customer research being conducted by Sensory UX or Consumer Insights, to bring exposure of the internal McCain R&D team to the consumer.
* Facilitates the running of robust, objective, and fit for purpose, round table/cook ups:



* With relevant McCain R&D/Technical Operations/Quality/Commercial team members, to make the right decisions at the right time regards prototypes, market samples etc, and/or to educate and immerse the team in product/category insight.
* The Sensory Scientist will lead moderation of such sessions, where it is appropriate. The Developer will also moderate for routine, lower risk panels.
* The set up is carried out by the R&D Product/Pack Developer, under guidance from the Sensory Scientist
* Courageously champions product design and product quality as the sensory representative on the Research & Development and business teams.
* Further strengthens best sensory practices within the Research & Development teams and provoke a ‘sensory’ and ‘experimental’ mindset.
* Applies design of experiments (DoE) to sensory and consumer/customer testing.
* Translates data to insights through synthesis of qualitative consumer/customer learning and interpretation of statistical analyses of quantitative sensory and consumer/customer data.
* Communicates key findings in a relevant and easy to understand manner and guide business teams to next steps in the product development process.
* Develops and fosters strong relationships with key sensory and consumer testing vendors (including research agencies, Universities etc) to ensure flawless execution of tests and appropriate pricing.
* Partners with the business to activate Product Stewardship programs. These focus on measuring and understanding the competitive space (internally or using external Trained Panel and consumer/customer research) and giving actionable guidance, that may lead to renovation activities.
* Works with The Sensory UX Innovation Manager, APACSA, to forward the Sensory UX agenda through the region. There may be occasions where participation in the broader McCain Sensory and UX team and/or R&D team is required eg team meetings, methodology review, relevant training sessions etc.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful.**

* Bachelor’s degree in Sensory Science, Food Science, Statistics, Psychology, or a related field.
* Master’s degree with emphasis in Sensory Science preferred.
* Minimum 4 years of sensory science and consumer research experience across multiple research methodologies.
* Experience planning and executing sensory and consumer research in collaboration with R&D and Consumer Insights teams.
* Strong understanding of sensory evaluation techniques, including discrimination testing, descriptive analysis, internal panel management, and consumer research methodologies.
* Working knowledge of applied statistics, Design of Experiments (DoE), and multivariate analysis techniques.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, synthesize complex data into actionable insights, and communicate findings effectively to diverse audiences.
* Experience managing external vendors and research partners is preferred.
* Knowledge of food chemistry, biochemistry, and statistics is desirable.
* Scientific curiosity and a strong commitment to experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning.

**About The Team.**
This role is part of the APACSA Sensory UX team and reports to the Sensory UX Innovation Manager, APACSA. The Sensory Scientist works closely with regional and global Sensory UX colleagues as well as cross-functional partners across R&D, Consumer Insights, Marketing, Operations, Packaging, and Commercial teams. The position plays an important role in strengthening McCain’s sensory capabilities and fostering a consumer-led innovation culture across the region.

title: Architect
description:
**Technical Skills Required**
Practical experience building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or document-QA systems over large, frequently updated document sets.
  
  
Experience with LLM prompt design and evaluation for extraction and summarization tasks, including techniques to reduce hallucination and enforce citation of source text.
  
  
Ability to build lightweight pipelines for document version-diffing and change detection.
  
  
Familiarity with structured output formats (JSON schemas, tagged requirement registers) so extracted requirements can feed downstream tools or dashboards.
  
  
Working knowledge of data handling and confidentiality practices appropriate to regulated financial services content.
  
  
Payment scheme certification spans several independent regulatory and scheme bodies, each with its own documentation, update cadence, and terminology: card networks (Visa, Mastercard), card data security (PCI DSS), UK Open Banking (AIS, PIS, CBPII functional certificates), EU/UK payment services regulation (PSD2, PSR, FCA), and messaging standards (ISO 20022, SEPA). Keeping up with these manually is slow and error-prone. The AI engineers in this role will build and operate AI-assisted workflows (document ingestion, retrieval-augmented interpretation, change detection) that convert raw regulatory and scheme documentation into structured, reviewable guidance that downstream users can act on without needing to parse the originals themselves.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Ingest and index regulatory and scheme source material (Visa/Mastercard mandate updates, PCI DSS standards, Open Banking functional certificate specifications, FCA/PSR publications, ISO 20022 message guides) into a retrieval system that stays current as sources are revised.
  
  
Build and maintain AI/LLM-based pipelines that extract certification requirements, deadlines, and scope changes from these sources, and that flag material changes between versions.
  
  
Translate extracted requirements into structured, plain-language summaries (requirement, applicability, deadline, evidence needed, owner) for consumption by compliance, product, and engineering teams who do not read the source documents directly.

title: Associate Consultant - Technology Strategy
description:
**What makes Gartner Consulting a GREAT fit for you?**
Gartner Consulting is an extension of Gartner’s world-renowned Research. We partner directly with CxOs across industry and government, helping organisations make smarter and faster decisions to achieve their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Our Consulting team is made up of strategists, innovators, consultants, digital experts, former practitioners, and technologists, delivering 2,100+ strategic consulting engagements annually. We deliver unbiased and independent solutions, helping change conventional thinking and accomplish ground-breaking results for our clients.
  
  
We are a diverse team of strategic thought leaders. As we continue to grow we look for great people to join us on that journey, and grow with us.
  
  
**About Role:**
Gartner Consulting is looking for an Associate Consultant who will work with some of the world’s largest enterprises on their mission-critical priorities. The Associate Consultant will support consulting teams through structured research, quantitative and qualitative analysis, development of insights, and creation of high-quality client deliverables across digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model and enterprise transformation engagements.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Work as a collaborative member of consulting teams serving some of the world’s largest enterprises, supporting engagements focused on digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model, enterprise transformation and other mission-critical priorities.
* Develop broad consulting experience across industries and practice areas, while building foundational capabilities in research, analytics, problem solving, client communication and engagement delivery.
* Develop an understanding of client objectives, industry context and potential obstacles; structure assigned work to support engagement priorities and client deliverables.
* Execute primary research and information-gathering activities, including collecting, organizing and validating client data, conducting market research and using Gartner research and benchmarks.
* Perform clearly structured quantitative, qualitative and technical analyses with guidance, applying relevant Gartner methodologies, frameworks and best practices.
* Test hypotheses using available evidence, identify patterns and anomalies, and translate research and analysis into straightforward insights, conclusions and recommendations with guidance.
* Summarize analyses and observations for specific client deliverables or broader teamwork, clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions and areas requiring further validation.
* Prepare high-quality client outputs, including executive presentations, assessment findings, workshop materials, roadmaps, business cases and written recommendations, using clear storylines and effective data visualization.
* Participate in client interviews, workshops and working sessions; listen actively, ask relevant clarifying questions, document requirements and decisions, and support agreed follow-up actions.
* Manage and prioritize assigned activities effectively, deliver work products within agreed timelines, and proactively communicate progress, dependencies, issues and risks to the engagement team.
* Take ownership of the accuracy and quality of facts, data and analyses presented; conduct self and peer review, flag anomalies or concerns, and incorporate feedback before work is shared.
* Invest in self-development, seek and apply coaching, participate in Gartner learning communities, and contribute to internal knowledge and intellectual capital development when requested.

**What you’ll need:**

* 2–4 years of professional experience in consulting, strategy, research, technology, business transformation or a related field. At least 2 years of Technology strategy consulting experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to gather, organize and analyze qualitative and quantitative information and convert it into clear observations or insights.
* Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous questions, test hypotheses, apply strategy consulting frameworks and draw evidence-based conclusions with guidance.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate general and technical messages clearly and in plain language.
* Experience developing high-quality presentations, analytical outputs or written deliverables, with strong attention to accuracy, consistency and detail.
* Curiosity about business and technology trends and an interest in how digital, data, cloud, automation and emerging technologies can improve business outcomes.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with data analysis, visualization, research or AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage.
* Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively with globally distributed and cross-border teams.
* A curious and inquisitive mindset, openness to feedback and new experiences, and the ability to learn quickly and work effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Bachelor’s degree required in engineering, technology, computer science, mathematics, statistics or a related discipline; an advanced degree in management is preferred.

**Who you are:**

* Self-starter and quick learner who takes ownership of assigned work and demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a commitment to client impact.
* Analytical thinker who approaches problems logically, asks relevant questions and uses evidence to develop sound conclusions.
* Clear communicator who can synthesize complex information into concise, audience-appropriate messages and high-quality deliverables.
* Collaborative team member who builds effective working relationships, responds well to coaching and actively incorporates feedback.
* Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage priorities, meet agreed timelines and proactively raise issues or concerns.
* Client-focused professional who listens actively, understands how assigned work connects to client objectives and takes responsibility for accuracy and quality.
* Committed to continuous learning, including developing awareness of Gartner methodologies, consulting best practices, business trends and the responsible use of approved AI-enabled productivity tools.

**What Gartner Consulting will offer you?**

* A world-class consulting environment.
* The opportunity to work on high-impact digital, technology strategy and enterprise transformation engagements with a tier one client portfolio.
* A competitive salary.
* Structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance.
* Opportunities for promotion with a clearly defined career development structure.
* Opportunity to participate actively in the development and future of Gartner Consulting.
* A dynamic but relaxed and supportive working environment that encourages personal development.

**About Gartner:**
Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading information technology research and advisory company. We deliver the technology-related insight necessary for our clients to make the right decisions, every day. We work with every client to research, analyze and interpret the business of IT within the context of their individual role. Founded in 1979, Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, U.S.A. – Visit gartner.com to discover more.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation, with direct influence on product direction.

For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.

**Preferred**

title: Associate (Procurement) - Performance Improvement CoE
description:
**About Us**

Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
  
  
**Who You Will Work With**
This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Performance Improvement Centre of Expertise (PI CoE). The PI CoE plays a crucial role in assisting case teams in India and abroad with various cost reduction/optimization activities by offering a range of solutions, including Procurement (e.g., Spend cube, analytics, maturity assessment, vendor strategy), Zero-based budgeting (e.g., Cost visibility, Budgeting, Initiative tracking, client training), Supply Chain (e.g., Inventory Diagnostics, Inventory Optimization, Network Optimization, Manufacturing Diagnostics, Integrated Business Planning), as well as cost diagnostics (e.g., Value Calculator, Net Working Capital), savings, and PMI Analysis. The CoE conducts complex and advanced data analysis to analyze clients' data and generate critical insights to help achieve cost objectives. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and employ powerful, dynamic visualizations/charts on various platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to showcase our results. The PI CoE is also involved in the creation of critical intellectual property (IP) that is valuable for new performance improvement cases globally at Bain.
  
  
**About You**

* Candidate should be a graduate/post-graduate with strong academic records and relevant experience in procurement, spend analysis, category management, cost transformation or performance improvement roles .

+ Procurement function, process, sourcing and Category specific experience is a Plus.

* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 3-5 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post-Graduate with high academic records having 1-3 years of relevant experience
* Excellent analytical skills, communication skills (ability to deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders), team management and project management skills
* Demonstrated ability to work with MS Excel and PowerPoint
* Knowledge of visualization and tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, PowerBI (Python is a Plus)
* Ability to deal with ambiguity, handle multiple tasks, dynamic case expectations and work in a team set up
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)

**What You’ll Do**
Work on problem solving, work-planning, analytics, research, and overall content to generate business insights and implications, deliver cases & deliverables. Role often requires leading a team of 1-2 analysts/ Workstream, based on case requirement. You will also help in developing intellectual property (IP), go-to-market materials, pitch documents and publications. The position reports into a Manager.
  
  

* Own end to end case delivery of Performance Improvement projects related to Procurement / Cost Transformation. This includes the following:

+ Assist case teams across Bain’s ecosystem to analyze the problem and deploy the most appropriate tool/solution.
+ Understand client’s data using P&L, ERP Systems, budgeting systems, supplier databases and purchase order systems to design the solution.
+ Deliver procurement solutions across multiple fronts including spend analytics, savings lever design, supplier analysis, strategic sourcing, savings initiative design, among others.
+ Create dashboards-based deliverables using Alteryx, Tableau, PowerBI or similar analytical tools.

* Utilize appropriate research sources and analytical tools to identify and employ relevant data-driven insights for effective decision-making.
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract information.
* Communicate data, knowledge, and clearly explain insights and implications for the client to the entire team.
* Effectively communicate with BCN leadership/case teams/end clients and manage relationships.
* Demonstrate a strong ability to quickly grasp various business domains, conducting research and analysis across diverse geographies and industries with agility and efficiency.
* Engage and ideate in developing new products/IP
* Deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Lead individual project work streams with the help of 1-2 directly aligned team members (analysts)
* Willing to groom a team of analysts and support them as and when required.

**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents..

title: Decision Analyst
description:
**Function: Data Analytics, Decision Science & Business Strategy**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced analytics professional to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets, develop robust quantitative models, and deliver actionable recommendations to support strategic business decisions. The role involves working with multiple internal and external data sources, conducting scenario analysis, monitoring model performance, and implementing data quality and governance controls.
  
  
The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, influence business decisions, manage complex analytical assignments, and contribute to operational effectiveness, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Analysis & Insights: Identify, extract, and analyze relevant data from multiple internal and external sources to generate meaningful business insights.
* Quantitative Modelling: Develop, implement, and validate quantitative models to support decision-making across various business functions.
* Sensitivity Analysis & Scenario Planning: Conduct sensitivity analysis, forecasting, and scenario modelling to evaluate potential business outcomes and support strategic planning.
* Model Performance & Validation: Monitor existing models, assess their effectiveness, identify performance gaps, and recommend improvements.
* Data Quality & Governance: Establish and implement data quality checks, validation procedures, and control mechanisms to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Business Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders and business leaders.
* Risk Management & Controls: Identify potential risks, strengthen control frameworks, and contribute to the development of policies and procedures supporting governance and compliance.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with business units and specialist teams to address complex problems, align analytical outcomes with business objectives, and influence decision-making.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve analytical methodologies, operational processes, model effectiveness, and overall business performance.

Communication & Reporting: Present complex or sensitive information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences, including senior management.
  
  
**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Lead complex analytical assignments and guide team members in delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Establish objectives, coach employees, evaluate performance, and support professional development where applicable.
* Provide expert advice on complex issues and support stakeholders in resolving escalated business challenges.
* Drive collaboration across business functions and identify opportunities to combine methodologies and specialist expertise.
* Promote accountability, operational excellence, effective risk management, and a strong control environment.
* For individual contributor roles, lead cross-functional projects, guide colleagues, and recommend new analytical approaches to achieve business outcomes.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong quantitative and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Experience in quantitative modelling, model validation, and performance monitoring.
* Ability to work with complex datasets from multiple sources.
* Knowledge of sensitivity analysis, scenario planning, and data quality management.
* Understanding of risk management, governance, and control frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex findings effectively.
* Experience leading projects, mentoring team members, or managing analytical teams, depending on the role structure.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to translate data-driven insights into practical recommendations.

**Key Success Factors**

* Deliver reliable, validated, and decision-oriented quantitative models.
* Improve data quality, analytical accuracy, and model performance.
* Provide actionable insights that support business strategy and operational effectiveness.
* Strengthen governance, risk management, and internal controls.
* Build effective cross-functional relationships and influence business outcomes.
