title: Analyst
description:
Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute are on a mission to build the next generation of business leaders equipped for a digital and AI-first world. We bring deep expertise across eCommerce, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Product and AI, and are building technology-enabled learning experiences for higher education and enterprise learning.

As a Analyst, you will work at the intersection of Product, Data, AI and Learning. You will contribute to the training, evaluation and improvement of AI models that power learning and assessment experiences, while using product and learner insights to identify opportunities and drive better product decisions.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys working with data, solving complex problems, understanding user behaviour and translating insights into impactful product improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Work on the training, evaluation and improvement of AI models that power learning and assessment experiences across higher education and enterprise learning.

• Partner with business, academic and technology teams to identify product opportunities and define clear problem statements.

• Analyse product usage data, learner behaviour and engagement metrics to uncover insights and guide product decisions.

• Work closely with Product Managers to prioritize features, define success metrics and track outcomes for ongoing and new initiatives.

• Conduct structured research, competitive benchmarking and user feedback analysis to identify improvement areas in the learning experience.

• Support end-to-end execution of pilot launches, A/B testing and post-launch analysis for new features or program modules.

• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that communicate product performance, trends and actionable insights to stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Content and Design teams to ensure seamless delivery of high-quality learner experiences.

**What We're Looking For**

• 1-3 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics or a similar analytical role.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable product insights.

• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL.

• Strong understanding of product metrics, data analysis and experimentation.

• Ability to analyse user behaviour and product data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

• Strong interest in AI/ML, LLMs and AI-powered products.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

• High ownership, curiosity and attention to detail.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and cross-functional environment.

**Why Join Us?**

**• Build AI-powered Education -**
Work on AI-powered products shaping the future of higher education and enterprise learning.

**• High-Growth Learning Environment -**
Work in a fast-scaling organization where ownership, innovation and excellence are valued.

**• Cross-Functional Exposure -**
Work closely with Business, Product, AI, Engineering, Content, Design and Academic teams.

**• Accelerated Career Growth -**
Take ownership of high-impact projects and build expertise across Product, AI and Learning.

**• Make a Meaningful Impact -**
Contribute to products designed to improve learning experiences and outcomes for thousands of learners.

**About the Company**

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception.

We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment.

We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

title: Market Risk Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Louis Dreyfus Company is a leading merchant and processor of agricultural goods. Our activities span the entire value chain from farm to fork, across a broad range of business lines, we leverage our global reach and extensive asset network to serve our customers and consumers around the world. Structured as a matrix organization of six geographical regions and ten platforms, Louis Dreyfus Company is active in over 100 countries and employs approximately 20,000 people globally.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Market risk team at LDC is responsible for producing quantitative market risk metrics along with qualitative assessment of potential risks to the company portfolio due to changes in market conditions. You will work closely with traders, risk managers, and other stakeholders to provide analysis, report risk metrics, and develop insights into market movements.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**

* Independently run and validate daily Market Risk calculations, including VaR and key risk metrics, ensuring data integrity, model stability, and timely delivery.
* Perform first-level analysis of VaR movements, identifying key drivers (price, positions, volatility) and escalating material changes with clear explanations to Management or Platform Risk Managers.
* Conduct deep-dive analysis on market exposures, linking risk movements to market fundamentals (e.g., price trends, supply/demand changes, basis movements).
* Generate and distribute daily risk reports to senior management, summarizing risk exposures, key metrics (e.g., Value at Risk (VaR), Margin Call Exposure), and historical trend analyses.
* Act as a key point of contact for various stakeholders, providing timely insights, challenging assumptions where appropriate, and supporting risk-informed decision-making.
* Continuously enhance and streamline risk reporting, improving transparency, consistency, and relevance to business decisions.
* Support and drive enhancements to risk tools, dashboards, and reporting frameworks, improving usability, efficiency, and data visibility across platforms.
* Contribute to enhancements in risk models and methologies (e.g. VaR assumptions, stress testing approaches)
* Explore and apply AI and data analytics tools to improve risk monitoring, anomaly detection, and reporting efficiency.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics and Finance or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience; strong programming skills are highly valued.
* English (Fluent)
* Prior experience in financial analysis or related roles is preferred, with exposure to physical and/or derivatives markets considered an advantage. Familiarity with commodities trading and market risk is a plus.
* Familiarity with market risk concepts and metrics, such as Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, and exposure analysis, with the ability to interpret and explain risk movements.
* Exposure to risk systems, data analysis tools, or reporting platforms (e.g.,Python, Power BI, or similar) to support risk monitoring and reporting processes.
* Experienced in designing data modelling/analytics.
* Exposure to process improvement, automation, or data-driven initiatives (including use of analytics tools or AI-assisted workflows) to enhance risk reporting and monitoring efficiency.

Additional Information
  

* Strong understanding of statistical and financial risk models, including practical application in risk measurement (e.g.VaR, stress testing, scenario analysis) and interpretation of outputs in a business context.
* Strong Programming skills in data analysis and automation tools such as Python, SAS, Java, HTML or similar, with the ability to analyze large datasets, improve workflows, and support automation initiatives.
* Experience in data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI), with the ability to build interactive dashboards and translate complex risk metrics into clear insights.
* Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to detect discrepancies in data and systems, ensuring the reliability of risk assessments.
* Exposure to advanced analytics or AI-assisted tools to enhance risk monitoring, anomaly detection, or reporting workflows.

We provide a dynamic and stimulating international environment, which will stretch and develop your abilities and channel your skills and expertise with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.

title: Global Product Senior Specialist - FDP 360 Platform
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

**Product Analyst**

Once requirements are defined, you will work closely with Solution Architects and Developers and independently lead implementation through design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. A key part of your role will be testing and validating data in Snowflake and BI reports to ensure solutions meet defined business and reporting requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities Would Include**

* Partner with SMEs to gather, clarify, and document business and reporting requirements.
* Translate business requirements into technical requirements, data needs, and implementation plans.
* Lead implementation with Solution Architects and Developers, coordinating work through delivery.

* Test and validate data in Snowflake and BI reports, identifying discrepancies and ensuring solutions meet defined requirements.
* Analyze data anomalies and gaps in business logic, determine root causes, and coordinate resolution of BI reporting issues through the ServiceNow ticketing system.
* Support global users and partner with technical teams to troubleshoot and resolve data and reporting issues.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, Finance reporting, data analytics, or related work.
* Hands-on Snowflake experience querying, analyzing, testing, and validating data.
* Experience with SAP BusinessObjects or comparable enterprise BI and reporting solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze complex data issues, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical requirements and working with technical teams through implementation.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills for working effectively across global, cross-functional teams.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a member of the Business Intelligence & Analytics Change Team, you will work closely with the Product Owner and subject matter experts to understand business and reporting needs, partnering with Solution Architects and Developers to translate those needs into scalable data and reporting solutions. You will also collaborate with Finance teams, Finance application owners, other Business Intelligence & Analytics teams, and global end users. As BCG’s BI environment evolves, you will work across existing SAP BusinessObjects reporting and emerging platforms, including Power BI and Sigma.

title: Impact Manager (Full-time / Remote)
description:
**About Generation:**

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

**JOB OBJECTIVES:**

The Impact Manager will strengthen Generation’s ability to measure, evaluate, and communicate durable impact across the global network. Reporting to the Lead, Impact Evaluation & Data Advocacy, this role will lead durability measurement and evaluation workstreams, deliver instruction and content for the Durability Academy, and serve as global D&I’s day-to-day counterpart on APAC and SAMEA.

This role combines research rigor, structured problem-solving, and the ability to teach and coach. The Impact Manager will independently own defined evaluation, research, and insight workstreams, manage vendor and research partner relationships, coach Durability Academy partner organizations, and produce high-quality materials for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders.

This is a remote position, based in the SAMEA region (India preferred).

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Durability & Impact Evaluation**

* Lead defined cross-country durability analyses (employment, earnings, job quality, financial health, and related metrics), from framing through final outputs
* Shape evaluation framing, research design, and methodological comparability across countries and program models
* Manage evaluations and research partnerships end to end, including scoping, vendor procurement, contracting support, data-sharing processes, and quality of deliverables
* Own evaluation briefs, synthesis memos, and funder-ready materials
* Ensure durability insights are grounded in consistent and reliable underlying data

**Durability Academy Instruction & Content**

* Co-facilitate cohort-wide Durability Academy sessions, taking ownership of selected modules over time
* Serve as a 1:1 coach for a portfolio of cohort partner organizations, guiding them through their theory of change, durability logframe, and measurement plans
* Maintain and improve Academy content between cohorts, including module materials, milestone documents, logframe templates, and facilitation guides
* Turn cohort work into reusable examples, case material, and practical guidance for future cohorts and the wider Durability Collective

**APAC & India Impact Priorities**

* Act as global D&I's day-to-day counterpart to Generation India and other APAC teams on evaluation, data, and impact priorities
* Coordinate regional evaluations and research partnerships, ensuring alignment with global methodology and standards
* Support regional teams on outcomes data, cost-per-learner and ROI inputs, and funder reporting
* Support onboarding and alignment of regional impact leads with global D&I tools and ways of working
* Surface regional insights and needs to D&I leadership to inform priorities and planning

**Structured Analysis & Insight Communication**

* Translate ambiguous leadership and funder questions into structured analytical approaches, and lead the resulting analyses
* Develop high-quality slide decks, workshop materials, and written summaries for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders
* Shape coherent impact narratives across decks, reports, and external-facing materials
* Contribute evidence, data, and methodology inputs to grant proposals and funder engagement

**Cross-Functional Delivery & Team Support**

* Manage timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across D&I workstreams, proactively flagging risks and reporting progress
* Partner with Impact Operations and Analytics colleagues to improve the clarity and consistency of core metrics (e.g., placement, durability indicators, income, living wage, ROI)
* Provide guidance and quality review for analyst-level work as needed
* Support D&I team operations such as recruitment and onboarding

**ATTRIBUTES (e.g. qualifications, knowledge, skills, and experience):**

***Required experience and skills:***

* 5+ years of experience in impact evaluation, monitoring & evaluation, research, analytics, consulting, policy, or related fields
* Track record of independently owning evaluation, research, or analytical workstreams from framing to delivery
* Experience managing external vendors, research partners, or academic collaborators
* Experience facilitating workshops, training, or coaching for professional audiences
* Strong structured thinking and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights
* Strong written communication and slide development skills, including materials for senior leadership or funders
* Comfort working with data (Excel required; SQL preferred)
* Ability to operate independently with significant ambiguity and manage multiple workstreams

***Preferred experience and skills:***

* Experience in workforce development, economic mobility, education, or related social sector work
* Experience working with teams in India or the wider SAMEA/APAC region
* Hands-on experience with survey design, research design, and impact evaluation methodologies, including quasi-experimental approaches
* Familiarity with adult learning principles or curriculum development
* Experience working with dashboards (e.g., Power BI) and interpreting metrics
* Fluency in additional languages beyond English

***Mindset:***

* Structured thinker who breaks down ambiguous questions into clear components and approaches, and helps others do the same
* Intellectually curious and motivated to understand the “why” behind outcomes, not just produce analysis
* Rigorous and practical, holding a high bar on evidence while keeping measurement useful for partners and programs
* Takes ownership, proactively flagging risks and proposing solutions
* Collaborative and low-ego, able to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders, cultures, and time zones
* Self-reflective and open to giving and receiving frequent feedback

title: Data Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
09
  
  
**Role Scope**
Data Steward is an individual contributor role responsible for executing core data stewardship activities that ensure the accuracy, integrity, and governance of enterprise data assets. The Data Steward manages end‑to‑end lineage monitoring, maintains high‑quality metadata, enforces policy and control compliance, and supports UAT for database changes and product distribution. Within the European Gas and Power Data team, the role supports the controlled transition of source data into internal databases and downstream delivery pipelines, ensuring raw data is validated, reconciled, transformed, and quality checked before it is made available to internal SMEs and external clients. The role performs detailed data validation, vendor data reviews, and works closely with Technology and Data Operations teams to resolve issues and maintain consistent data standards across systems.
  
  
Additionally, the Data Steward contributes to process improvement by driving standardization, enhancing documentation, and supporting the adoption of automation and AI‑enabled capabilities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and strengthen operational efficiency. We are looking for a process-orientated, methodological thinker with a keen eye for detail. Someone who enjoys dealing with large sets of data and problem solving.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)**
**Operational Delivery**

* Perform data validation checks, lineage tracking, and metadata updates to maintain data quality, integrity, and traceability.
* Execute data ingestion, validation, and integration activities in alignment with governance and control standards.
* Ensure consistent adherence to enterprise data policies and governance frameworks.
* Execute defined controls and compliance requirements to safeguard data integrity and lineage.
* Support vendor data reviews and onboarding through data quality assessments, validation checks, and issue resolution.
* Maintain data standardization, stewardship documentation, and process artifacts to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Execute medium‑complexity stewardship and validation tasks under established guidelines, escalating exceptions when required.
* Respond to client data queries, resolving issues and coordinating issue triage with Operations and Client Services teams.
* Collaborate with Technology teams on defect resolution, enhancement requests, and UAT for backend data and dataflow changes.
* Contribute to automation and AI‑enabled improvements that enhance efficiency and strengthen stewardship capabilities.
* Investigate, validate, troubleshoot, and support controlled updates to transformation scripts, data quality rules, and pipeline logic using Python, SQL and PySpark, ensuring automated processes continue to run to schedule producing accurate outputs.
* Support onboarding of new datasets required by SMEs by reviewing source structures, validating expected outputs, identifying data quality risks, and coordinating required pipeline or source data changes within the existing architecture.

**Process Excellence**

* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating data, coordinating test execution, and assisting with defect identification and resolution.
* Ensure adherence to governance, data management standards, and operating procedures by following defined controls and compliance requirements.
* Maintain high‑quality documentation by updating process flows, data definitions, data dictionaries, and other stewardship artifacts to ensure audit readiness and operational clarity.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Data Operations and Technology teams to support governance activities, quality controls, source amendments, validation outcomes and issue remediation while serving as a key liaison between governance expectations and day‑to‑day execution
* Support Product and Technology teams by assisting with data requirements, validations, and operational coordination throughout change cycles.
* Assist with vendor data reviews by conducting data quality checks, performing validations, and coordinating onboarding processes.

**How Impact Will Be Measured (Success Metrics)**

* Data accuracy and integrity - Maintain high accuracy rates through consistent validation, timely corrections, and adherence to defined quality thresholds.
* SLA and turnaround adherence - Meet or exceed service‑level timelines for data updates, validations, issue resolution, and stakeholder responses.
* Documentation completeness and currency - Keep process documentation, data dictionaries, lineage records, and stewardship artifacts up‑to‑date, audit‑ready, and fully aligned with governance standards.
* Pipeline quality and delivery - Ensure transformation scripts, database workflows, quality checks, and scheduled processes run successfully, with failures investigated, validated, resolved, or coordinated through to closure in line with operational priorities.

**For This Role You'll Need to Have (Skills & Competencies)**
**Technical Skills**

* Intermediate Python scripting skills, including the ability to investigate, maintain, debug, and support controlled updates to transformation logic, automation scripts, and data quality checks.
* Intermediate SQL capability to query, reconcile, transform, validate, and troubleshoot data across relational databases and pipeline outputs.
* Hands-on experience with PySpark or distributed data processing to support investigation, validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across large or complex datasets.
* Working knowledge of Databricks, including notebooks, jobs, clusters, and pipeline monitoring, would be advantageous.
* Understanding of cloud computing, preferably AWS.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML workflows.
* Works with metadata management and lineage tools to maintain data transparency and trace end‑to‑end data flows.
* Possess foundational familiarity with BI tools and dashboards to review outputs and identify data anomalies.

**Functional Skills**

* Possesses solid domain and process understanding
* Understands data governance fundamentals, including data quality controls, stewardship roles, and ownership models.
* Supports data standardization by applying consistent data definitions, formats, and controlled processes.
* Has working knowledge of data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and integration workflows, with the ability to investigate pipeline failures, check source-to-target accuracy, support root cause resolution, and coordinate remediation actions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data requirements/issues and generate innovative ideas and solutions.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Demonstrates strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in data, documentation, and validation activities, functional teams cause analysis.
* Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively with cross functional teams including Technology, Operations, Product, and Vendor partners.
* Applies analytical mindset, critical thinking & creative problem solving to build solutions for business problems and while investigating data issues and remediation through root cause analysis.
* Demonstrates learning agility, digital acumen, initiative, and ownership in data stewardship activities, adapting to evolving tools and technologies while working effectively through ambiguity to investigate issues, and support timely delivery against operational priorities.

**Preferred Education & Experience**

title: Architect – AI-Powered Performance Verification Automation
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel.
  
  
NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today.
  
  
We are looking for a motivated engineer to drive the transformation of performance verification workflows through AI and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy solutions that accelerate verification cycles, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort across hardware performance verification project lifecycles. You will be at the forefront of redefining how performance verification is done at scale — replacing repetitive manual analysis with intelligent, self-improving automation that helps engineers focus on what matters most.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Automate verification workflows by building AI/ML-based tools that generate, triage, and analyse performance test cases and results
* Develop intelligent agents that can identify performance regressions, root-cause failures, and recommend corrective actions
* Integrate LLM-based assistants into existing verification infrastructure to enable natural-language querying of results, specs, and coverage data
* Design data pipelines to collect, curate, and label verification data for model training and continuous improvement
* Collaborate with verification engineers to understand pain points, define automation priorities, and validate AI-driven solutions against real-world workflows
* Establish metrics and dashboards to measure automation impact (cycle time reduction, coverage improvement, engineer productivity)
* Stay current with state-of-the-art techniques in generative AI, reinforcement learning, and formal methods as they apply to hardware verification

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech/M.Tech/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in hardware verification, performance validation, or EDA tool development
* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with C/C++, SystemVerilog/UVM is a plus
* Hands-on experience with ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) or LLM APIs (OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM/NeMo)
* Understanding of performance verification methodologies (benchmarking, profiling, regression analysis)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience applying ML to EDA or verification problems (e.g., coverage closure, bug prediction, test generation)
* Familiarity with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.)
* Knowledge of NVIDIA GPU/SoC architecture or similar complex hardware platforms
* Published work or patents in AI-for-verification or related domains

title: Consumer Science Product Intelligence - Senior Scientist
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Consumer Science and Product Intelligence (CSPI) Wellness India Senior Scientist role is a strategic and operational role that ensures we put the Consumer First, Always in everything we do. The role leads consumer science and product intelligence for the Wellness portfolio in India, partnering across R&D, Category, Innovation and Commercial teams to develop, deliver and review innovations and in-market products so they win with consumers at the point of purchase and throughout the usage experience, delivering meaningful and noticeable superiority.
  
  
Critical elements of the role are:
  
  

* Provide insights and evidence that enable consumer-led Wellness innovations that deliver meaningful and noticeable superiority.
* Champion the “Consumer First, Always” approach for Wellness India from early insight and prototype development through claims support, launch and post-launch review.
* Lead consumer and product intelligence for Wellness India to guide product, portfolio, claims, communication and renovation decisions.
* Build a clear understanding of the India Wellness landscape, including competitors, product performance, consumer reviews, complaints, claims evidence and emerging format trends.
* Translate global category strategies into locally relevant India execution, while using local insights to influence global innovation decisions.
* Bring actionable local consumer and product insights to Category teams and wider R&D, partnering with CBIA where appropriate.
* Drive faster, better innovation using ideal product models and evidence-based product narratives through the stage-gate process.
* Ensure consumer testing in India is compliant, fit for purpose and aligned with agreed work processes.
* Partner with Category, Innovation, Commercial, R&D and Medical & Scientific Affairs to focus CSPI resources on high-impact opportunities and develop consumer-relevant claims, demos, visualisations and communications.
* Use evidence to support prioritisation and deploy Wellness India CSPI resources where they can most improve consumer choice, usage and repeat purchase.

**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
E2E Consumer Science for Wellness India
  
  

* Select and apply fit-for-purpose consumer science, product research and sensory methods according to each project’s decision, risk and value.
* Deliver consumer and product evidence to identify superiority, guide product design, support claims, and create compelling product stories and visualisations versus competition
* Develop and apply leading-edge testing methods, including AI- and digitally enabled tools, to improve decision speed and deliver noticeable, meaningful product superiority.
* Lead end-to-end consumer evidence delivery from early need definition and prototype learning through formulation lock, launch and post-launch optimisation.
* Validate non-clinical claims with consumers using robust qualitative and quantitative research.
* Conduct post-launch reviews, monitor complaints and use insights to improve India Wellness products.
* Track emerging trends through social listening, market signals and product intelligence to guide pipeline and portfolio decisions.

Integrated Product Experience and Insight Generation
  
  

* Integrate consumer research, product performance, complaints, reviews, commercial signals and competitor benchmarking into unified product intelligence that guides India Wellness decisions.
* Build understanding of what drives trial, usage, repeat purchase and priority product formats in India.
* Identify consumer jobs to be done, usage occasions and unmet needs with Category CSPI to inform superior product design.
* Partner with Sensory Scientists to integrate sensory-panel and consumer evidence into clear product-design decisions.

Product Intelligence
  
  

* Maintain a clear, evidence-based view of the India Wellness product landscape in partnership with Category CSPI.
* Lead product benchmarking to identify where Haleon products are superior, at parity or exposed versus competitors.
* Translate benchmarking into recommendations on where to renovate, defend, premiumise, simplify or avoid over-investment.
* Identify product and experience gaps that could improve consumer choice, usage, repeat purchase and business outcomes.

Capability, Governance and Collaboration
  
  

* Build and share Consumer Science & Product Intelligence best practices and capabilities.
* Champion consumer closeness and coach R&D colleagues outside CSPI in consumer-led decision making.
* Ensure consumer interactions comply with the Human Subject Testing Policy and all quality and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate directly with R&D, CBIA and Marketing teams to deliver decisions effectively in a matrixed environment.

**Why you?**
**Basic Qualifications:**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* BSc degree or equivalent in an appropriate subject.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience, preferably within FMCG/CPG or Healthcare.
* Appropriate specialisations include Chemistry, Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Physics, Mathematics, Sensory Science, Food Science, Biochemistry or Biological Science.
* Preferred: MSc degree in an appropriate scientific discipline. Essential Capabilities
* Broad experience across consumer science, product research, sensory/product experience, claims evidence and product intelligence, with the ability to select fit-for-purpose approaches.
* Connect consumer science and product intelligence to clear business outcomes and growth.
* Lead through cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders.
* Turn complex priorities and evidence into simple, practical recommendations.
* Shape product, portfolio, claims and communication decisions with strong evidence and judgement.
* Apply commercial judgement and integrate multiple data sources into clear, actionable insights.
* Develop and embed novel methodologies that deliver business impact.
* Demonstrate strong analytical, strategic, communication and change-leadership skills.
* Experience across qualitative and quantitative research, consumer modelling, consumer need definition, product validation and claims substantiation.
* Commercially savvy, entrepreneurial and collaborative, with experience independently leading research programmes and solving problems in a matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Ability to problem solve
* Scientific expertise
* Project management experience
* Experience analyzing data
* Ability to influence others

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-14
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

title: Evidence Lead, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.About 2AI India And EAII AdvisorsEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Data Scientist
  
  
Job Title: Senior Data Scientist, Executive Reporting Centre of Excellence
  
  
Product Data & Analytics is a centralized global team that enables Mastercard product business units to make better data‑driven decisions. We build internal analytics partnerships that strengthen focus on business performance, portfolio and revenue optimization, initiative tracking, new product development, and go‑to‑market strategies. These capabilities are underpinned by our data platforms that enable insights to be delivered in a standardized, scalable, and cost‑efficient manner.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly analytical and business-oriented Senior Data Scientist to drive enterprise-level KPI reporting, business performance tracking, and strategic analytics initiatives across global business units and regions.
  
  
The role will be responsible for owning end-to-end analytics solutions from requirement gathering, conceptualization, KPI framework design, data engineering, dashboard development, stakeholder alignment, finance automation, and ongoing commercialization of reporting solutions. The candidate will partner with global business leaders, Finance, FP&A, data providers, and technology teams to transform complex business requirements into scalable analytical products that enable executive decision-making. This role requires a unique combination of business acumen, technical expertise, product thinking, and team leadership capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and manage executive-level KPI reporting across multiple business units, products, and regions.
* Design and implement scalable KPI measurement frameworks, reporting methodologies, and governance processes.
* Develop and maintain analytics solutions, dashboards, and reporting products using Tableau, Power BI, SQL, and Python.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and operational scalability.
* Lead finance automation initiatives that transform manual FP&A reporting packs into governed, scalable, role-based dashboards and financial intelligence layers.
* Partner with global stakeholders to gather requirements, define metrics, resolve reporting issues, and provide actionable insights.
* Monitor data quality, perform validations, and ensure accuracy of business-critical reporting.
* Lead cross-functional projects from conceptualization through implementation, commercialization, and business adoption.
* Translate complex business problems into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions for senior leadership.
* Evaluate, identify, and integrate GenAI and AI capabilities into existing products and business processes.
* Contribute to AI product roadmap planning by identifying opportunities for AI-driven features, automation, insights generation, and user experience enhancements.
* Collaborate with technology teams to define AI solution architecture, integration requirements, data dependencies, and governance standards.
* Mentor and guide team members on technical tools, analytics best practices, AI adoption, and business processes.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, prioritize deliverables, and ensure timely execution of strategic initiatives.

Job Requirements
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Product Analytics, Product Management, or related fields.
* Experience designing and managing enterprise-level KPI frameworks and executive reporting solutions with proven ability to build scalable analytics products and automate reporting processes.
* Experience automating finance or FP&A reporting processes, including revenue, expense, driver, budget, forecast, and P&L reporting, with strong understanding of financial data governance and validation.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, AI agents, and enterprise AI use cases.
* Experience evaluating, planning, and integrating AI capabilities into business products and analytical solutions.
* Understanding of AI solution architecture, data flows, API integrations, model governance, and deployment considerations.
* Ability to translate business requirements into product roadmaps and identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, data validation, performance measurement, and reporting governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working across global teams and senior leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, strategic thinking, and product planning capabilities.
* Experience working in Agile/Product-oriented environments; CSPO, CSM, Product Management, AI, or Cloud certifications are preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Manager - Data Science
description:
**About noon**

We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, who can help us move even faster.

noon’s mission: Every door, every day.

**What you'll do**

* ***Applied AI, analytics automation and internal tools (must have***
  *)*

• Lead analytics automation by connecting LLMs to governed data: certified metrics, curated tables and semantic layers.

•Ensure AI-generated insights are accurate, explainable and secure, with clear evaluation, transparency and data governance built in from the start.

• Build internal tools and self-serve products that help teams answer their own questions and reduce ad-hoc requests.

• Spot opportunities nobody has asked for yet, and turn the best into solutions teams actually adopt.

* ***Data science***

• Build solutions that shape how customers discover, engage with, and buy on noon, from personalized recommendations to a smarter, more relevant app experience.

• Choose the simplest method that works, and measure models on business outcomes, not just offline accuracy.

* ***Product analytics and experimentation***

• Partner with PMs on what to build and how to measure it: North Star and guardrail metrics, funnels, cohorts, opportunity sizing and A/B test design and readouts.

• Own experimentation standards, from randomization, power and pre-registered metrics to novelty effects and clear ship/kill decisions.

• Push back when the data doesn't support a decision, and propose what to do instead.

* ***Lead and grow the team***

• Manage analysts and data scientists: hiring, goals, reviews, coaching and hard performance conversations when needed.

• Allocate capacity across squads and run a clear intake and prioritization process with Product.

• Raise the quality bar by reviewing analyses, test designs and models before they reach stakeholders.

* ***Communicate and influence***

• Turn complex data into clear recommendations and actionable stories for leadership.

• Build trust with Product, Engineering and Business by being direct, timely and right.

**What you bring**

• 7–9 years in product analytics, data science or growth analytics, ideally in e-commerce, marketplaces or consumer tech at scale.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**
Bain’s AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Have**
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
**The Role**
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:

+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
+ Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
+ Embedding generation and optimization
+ Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)

* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:

+ Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
+ Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards

* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:

+ Hallucination rate and factual consistency
+ Relevance and precision/recall
+ Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
+ Cost tracking and efficiency

* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8–12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment

, you will support ERM's global consulting delivery by providing technical expertise in air dispersion modeling, environmental permitting, air quality assessments projects. * Over 5+ years of experience in air quality dispersion modeling, air permitting, air quality assessments studies, emissions management, or environmental compliance projects across industrial sector.

description:
AI at Cvent: Leading the Future
   

  

 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams \- Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official ‘name@cvent.com’ email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 The Analytics team is Cvent's internal intelligence engine — the function that powers how the business understands performance, serves commercial teams, and accelerates decision making with data and AI. Within this organization, the AI Engineering \& Data Science team designs and deploys production grade AI and ML solutions with a primary mandate across commercial and growth teams \- Sales, Marketing, Revenue, Growth teams and others.
   

  

 This role is designed for an experienced practitioner ready to step into a leadership position alongside the Head of Data Science \& AI. As Manager, you will own delivery, people, and technical standards while remaining a hands\-on contributor who can architect and build alongside your team. You are not being hired to manage from a distance — you are being hired to raise the floor and the ceiling of what the team can do.
   

  

 The right person for this role brings commercial instinct alongside technical depth. You understand how commercial teams operate, can translate sales and marketing problems into AI solutions, and know how to take work reliably from prototype to production. You are also a developer of people: you build individual capability, hold high standards, and create an environment where engineers grow.
   

  

**AI \& Data Science Function**
* Partner with the Head of Data Science \& AI to run the team — owning delivery execution, team health, stakeholder relationships, and technical direction on a day\-to\-day basis.
* Serve as the senior technical expert and partner with Architects to set architectural direction, lead design reviews, and make build\-vs\-buy decisions that shape how solutions are structured and scaled.
* Represent the team in cross\-functional forums — with commercial and technical teams translating AI capability nto business language and AI business needs into engineering scope.


**Own End\-to\-End AI Delivery**
* Lead delivery across the full AI and ML lifecycle — from problem framing and data acquisition through model development, evaluation, deployment, and post\-production monitoring.
* Set and enforce engineering standards: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD for ML pipelines, observability, reproducibility, and documentation. Build a culture that ships with both quality and speed.
* Design and implement agentic AI workflows — LLM orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), natural language querying (NLQ), multi\-step reasoning pipelines, and human\-in\-the\-loop architectures — across internal commercial and operational use cases.
* Own the team's AI observability posture: output quality monitoring, drift detection, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that keep production systems reliable, explainable, and auditable.


**Drive AI Use Cases**
* Partner closely with cross functional stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI solutions that improve pipeline quality, conversion rates, and revenue predictability.
* Lead development of Sales and Marketing AI applications — lead scoring, next best action, intent signal modelling, account health prediction, churn early warning, and conversational analytics.
* Translate commercial problems into well\-scoped AI initiatives with defined success metrics, baseline comparisons, and measurable business outcomes. Own the narrative when presenting to commercial teams’ leadership.
* Proactively surface new AI use cases with business partners — qualify opportunities by strategic impact and technical feasibility and build the internal case before pursuing them.


**Build and Develop the Team**
* Directly manage a team of data scientists and AI engineers — owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, and individual development plans.
* Run structured 1:1s focused on technical growth and career progression. Maintain a skills matrix and design development plans that close capability gaps systematically.
* Foster a high\-performance delivery culture: rigorous code review, clear working rhythms, cross\-functional stakeholder accountability, and a bias toward shipping working solutions over perfect prototypes.


**Shape AI Platform and Architecture**
* Work with Data Engineering and the Head of Data Science \& AI to evolve the team's tooling stack — model registry, feature pipelines, LLM orchestration layer (LangChain, LangSmith, or equivalent), and evaluation infrastructure.
* Contribute to Snowflake as Cvent's enterprise intelligence layer — ensuring ML feature pipelines, semantic layers, and AI workloads are architected for reliability, reuse, and long\- term auditability.
* Embed responsible AI practices into delivery: privacy assessments, governance reviews, and alignment with Cvent's AI usage policies throughout the build lifecycle.


**Experience**
* 10\-13\+ years in data science or AI/ML engineering, with a minimum of 2 years in a people management or formal technical lead role with clear delivery ownership.
* Demonstrated track record delivering AI and ML solutions for commercial team — lead scoring, churn prediction, intent modelling, revenue forecasting, NLQ, or comparable commercial applications — in a SaaS or B2B environment.
* Experience working with Salesforce, Marketo, or equivalent GTM platforms as primary data sources. Familiarity with how commercial data flows from CRM to analytics is essential.


**Technical Depth**
* Strong AI engineering fundamentals: LLM application development, RAG and NLQ architectures, agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent), prompt engineering, and model evaluation at production scale.
* Hands\- on ML expertise across the full lifecycle: feature engineering, model training and selection, A/B and champion\-challenger testing, deployment, monitoring, and drift management in production.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL. Hands\-on experience with Databricks (MLflow, Delta Lake, Jobs) and Snowflake (Cortex, ML functions, feature pipelines) as the core delivery stack.
* Experience with vector databases and semantic search infrastructure — OpenSearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or equivalent — for embedding\-based retrieval in RAG and NLQ systems.
* Hands\-on ability to build internal AI applications and data tools using Streamlit, React, or Node.js — from early prototype to production\-ready product.
* Familiarity with AI observability tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse, Datadog, or equivalent) and ML experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights \& Biases).


**Leadership and Collaboration**
* Proven ability to co\-lead a team — setting direction, holding standards, developing people, and creating delivery accountability without micromanaging execution.
* Fluency working across Data Engineering, BI, and business teams — translating between technical model requirements and downstream pipeline, reporting, and stakeholder workflow needs.
* Strong commercial communication: the ability to frame AI solutions in terms of business outcomes, present findings, and defend modelling decisions under scrutiny.
* A hunter's instinct: proactively identifying where AI creates leverage, building internal business cases, and expanding the team's scope through demonstrated impact — not just by executing assigned work.

title: Commercial & Transformation Lead
description:
**Mission Brief** 




  





 Transform how Lenskart buys, negotiates and creates value from every rupee it spends.
 



 Lenskart is scaling rapidly across manufacturing, retail, supply chain and multiple geographies. At this scale, commercial decisions are no longer just about procurement. They are a strategic lever for growth, margin and competitive advantage.
 



 The opportunity is to bring greater intelligence, discipline and technology into how we manage external spend, from manufacturing inputs and logistics to retail, technology and corporate categories.
 



 Your mandate is to close the gap between what we spend and what we should spend and create a commercial engine that is data\-led, AI\-enabled and deeply connected to the business.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous business problems and turning those solutions into measurable outcomes.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  





 Commercial Intelligence \& AI
 



 Shape Lenskart’s commercial intelligence layer across:
 


* Spend analytics, should\-cost models and total\-cost\-of\-ownership frameworks
* Supplier intelligence, scorecards and risk assessment
* E\-sourcing and contract intelligence
* AI\-assisted negotiation and price discovery
* Automated, data\-led decision making across categories



  





 The goal is to move from fragmented information and manual decision\-making to a system where
 **the data tells us where the opportunity is and technology helps us act on it.** 




  





 Strategic Sourcing \& P\&L Impact
 



 Own the commercial opportunity across a broad spend universe:
 



**Direct:** 
 Frames, lenses, coatings, accessories, packaging and manufacturing inputs
 



**Indirect:** 
 Store CapEx and OpEx, marketing, technology and corporate spend
 



**Supply Chain:** 
 Logistics, last\-mile, lab\-to\-store, make\-vs\-buy and network optimisation
 



 You will be expected to identify structural opportunities, develop category strategies and deliver measurable YoY P\&L impact through
 **should\-cost, TCO, value engineering and smarter commercial models.** 




  





 Negotiation \& Supplier Strategy
 



 Lead some of Lenskart’s highest\-value commercial negotiations while establishing greater negotiation rigour across the organisation.
 



  





 This includes developing stronger supplier strategies, benchmarking markets, understanding cost structures, defining negotiation playbooks and creating clear walk\-away positions.
 



 The objective is not simply to
 **negotiate harder** 
 , but to fundamentally improve the economics of the relationships we enter into.
 



  





 Business Problem Solving \& Leadership
 



 This role sits at the intersection of multiple parts of the business.
 



 You will work closely with
 **Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, Technology and Marketing** 
 , as well as the founders and senior leadership team, on problems where the answer is not always obvious.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 


* Break down complex business problems into clear commercial decisions.
* Challenge existing ways of working using data and first\-principles thinking.
* Translate business requirements into technology and AI solutions.
* Take ideas from analysis through implementation and measurable impact.
* Influence stakeholders across functions and drive adoption at scale.



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **thinks like a business leader, not a functional specialist.** 




 You may come from strategy, consulting, business operations, supply chain, sourcing, procurement, corporate development or a high\-growth operating environment.
 



 What matters is that you have demonstrated:
 


* Strong problem\-solving ability across ambiguous, high\-impact business situations.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts.
* Exposure to supply chain, sourcing, cost structures or commercial strategy.
* The ability to connect
 **strategy, economics, technology and execution.**
* A track record of taking ownership for outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Curiosity and instinct to use AI and technology to fundamentally improve how work gets done.



 Experience with
 **manufacturing, APAC, China or Middle East supply ecosystems** 
 is a strong advantage.
 



  





 Why This Role
 



**This is not a traditional procurement role.** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most consequential commercial problems at Lenskart, with visibility into the decisions that shape
 **margin, supply chain, capital allocation and growth.** 




  





 You will work closely with the
 **founders and senior leadership** 
 , operate across the full business and have significant ownership over the direction of the commercial function.
 



 The scale is substantial:
 **2,500\+ stores, hundreds of suppliers, multiple geographies and an increasingly complex manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.** 




  





 The opportunity is to combine
 **business problem solving, commercial strategy, supply chain thinking and technology** 
 to create a capability that can materially change Lenskart’s economics.

title: Associate, Investment Performance Analysis, Tech & Ops
description:
**About This Role**
 Business Unit Overview:
   

  

 The Performance Measurement \& Attribution team is responsible for the outcome and interpretation of portfolio \& benchmark return analytics in Blackrock, critical to insights that enable investment and risk teams to make informed decisions. This includes generating and interpreting analytical outcomes, leading product \& strategy level support, acting as a centralized source and applying analytical tools and automated solutions that standardize calculators \& methodologies, reduce time\-to\-market and bring consistency across our analytics.
   

  

 The demand for accurate, timely \& informational performance data is central to many of the organizational core objectives, and are core to the analytical and global client service culture of the team. Products covered by the team are the spectrum of Mutual Funds, ETF’s, segregated clients and investment asset classes including Fixed Income, Multi\-Asset, Equity and Alternatives.
   

  

**Background And Development Value**
 Do you want to build a foundation in performance, and learn to provide investment and technology solutions with purpose to help our clients meet their goals? As a member of PMA, take part in the story and take ownership as a performance expert. We are responsible for investment performance and attribution analysis globally across Fixed Income, Equity and Multi\-Asset strategies. You get to work with multiple business divisions, including the iShares Equity Product suite, Institutional Equity, Beta Strategies, and Fixed Income products. The team focuses on using technology and project management to improve existing processes to optimize content delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with teams globally to present a consistent client experience catalyzing a common culture.
* Lead and oversee accurate and timely performance reporting across multiple fund groups, ensuring smooth data flow between systems and teams.
* Drive resolution of residuals using the Aladdin platform and proactively identify improvements in execution.
* Deepen expertise in internal analytical systems (Aladdin) to investigate complex client inquiries and support evolving business needs.
* Mentor and guide junior colleagues, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration. Lead cross\-regional transitions and changes to reporting platforms, ensuring seamless execution.
* Champion efficiency and capacity\-building initiatives, including automation and standardization efforts, employing BlackRock’s technology platform.


**Knowledge/Experience**
* Strong conceptual and practical understanding of performance and attribution concepts
* Strong domain knowledge in Multi\-Asset, Fixed Income, and Equity instruments, along with general performance principles.
* 5–8 years of experience in Performance and Attribution within the asset management industry
* Experience in leading reporting platform migrations and handling cross\-regional transitions.
* Advanced programming skills in SQL, Python, and Power BI; passion for learning new technologies and deepening Aladdin attribution expertise.


**Skills/Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent; prior experience with business modeling techniques and/or attribution tools (CFA or CIPM designation a plus).
* Ability to work independently and lead initiatives; strong problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Forward\-thinking and passionate about outcomes; able to synthesize information, summarize issues, and drive solutions.
* Proven success in mentoring junior colleagues and building team capability.
* Experience with performance tools and external fund administrators a plus


**Competencies**
 We pride ourselves on our diverse approaches and thinking styles. We want an excellent communicator (verbal and written), who displays strong interpersonal interactions, and can operate in a distributed team environment. Someone with a sharp control/risk mitigation attitude, and positive get\-the\-job\-done demeanor
   

  

**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
